title: A sandbox galaxy
summary: Patch 0019 turns the game into a sandbox. A new game starts you on foot on Amnissos, by a city's landing field, with no ship and no story to follow: the cities' ore buyers, couriers and local pilots are how you make your first drachmas and get about, a scanner finds ore and places, and an interactive tutorial - a small panel, never in the way, kept in your saves - pays you step by step toward your first ship and then teaches you to fly, dock and fight. The maps are 3D, the galaxy has grown to 120 systems spread through its volume and hidden until you visit them. Everyone in the sector now lives a tracked life, the traders are the economy's own ships - land square on their pads, walk up their ramps into rooms fitted inside their hulls, sit in their passenger seats and ride them through the gates while your own ship waits where you left it, ready to be recalled. And a free mouse, mouse-button bindings, faster frames and a handful of fixes.

steps.title: A sandbox: start on foot
steps.text: A new game starts you on foot on Amnissos, the green ocean world of the Minoans' home system, by a city's landing field - with no ship yet: your pulse rifle, your mining beam and the new scanner. There's no main quest any more: the galaxy is yours to make your way in.

steps.title: Making a living
steps.text: Every city has three people by its landing field: the ore buyer pays for the raw ore you mine, the courier's office gives you packages to carry to towns on other worlds and to stations (about 300-480 dr each), the local pilot flies you there for a small fee. Raiders' bounties are vouchers now, handed in at a station's harbour office.

steps.title: Hired rides
steps.text: The local pilot's ship comes down on the town's field and waits with its ramp down; walk up it and it lifts off, swings round the world, crosses the system and comes down by the other world's town - or onto a station's pad, down into its port. Walk off down the ramp.

steps.title: The scanner
steps.text: Z on foot: a pulse goes out and marks for a minute the ore deposits within 600 m and the places within 14 km - towns, caves and dungeons, pirate camps, lairs, armed creatures - with their names and distances.

steps.title: The interactive tutorial
steps.text: A small panel at the top right: the next thing to learn and what it pays. Seventeen steps, done in any order, each paid when done - 3,090 dr in all, 1,500 of it for your first ship. On foot, then your ship. A ship got another way ends it once you've flown, docked and fought, with every reward. Kept in your saves; F2 hides it.

steps.title: Your first ship
steps.text: A station's shipyard sells you your first ship when you have none - nothing to trade in. It comes down that port's lift onto a pad, yours.

steps.title: The 3D maps
steps.text: The solar map and the galaxy map are 3D: drag to turn, pan, zoom to the cursor; click for a detailed panel on what you picked; set a course. The galaxy has grown to 120 systems spread through its volume, and only the systems you've visited show - the lanes to the others fade into question marks.

steps.title: Riding the traders
steps.text: Walk up a trader's ramp in a port and you're aboard its rooms, fitted inside its hull - the hold, the quarters, the bridge. Stay aboard and it takes you with it, across the system and through the gates; walk off at its next port. Your own ship stays where you left it - recall it to a port (B) and it comes, from another system too.

steps.title: The passenger seat
steps.text: Beside the pilot's chair of the ships you ride, a passenger seat: sit, and the camera goes outside the ship - turn it and zoom as you do your own; you don't fly it.

steps.title: The sector's people
steps.text: Everyone in the sector is a person with a life: work, money, family, friends, a ship to crew or own, the navy at war. The people in a port work there, live there or came in on a ship down on its lift - follow one back to their ship and that ship on to its next port.

steps.text: The traders set down on landing gear sized to their hulls and lower a stern ramp in port; a doorway is cut in the hull over it while it's down (the hull shader's cutaway).

steps.title: The mouse and the keys
steps.text: Ctrl + right click frees the mouse: click to select, hold and drag to steer, right click for the actions menu; Ctrl + right click captures it again. Mouse buttons are bindings like keys, rebindable in Settings. Alt+Tab lets the mouse go.

steps.title: Packages in your hands
steps.text: The characters set a box down and pick it up - a squat, both hands at its sides, the feet planted - and carry it with their palms flat on it.

steps.title: Ports put right
steps.text: The ports' crate stacks stand on the floor (one layer had been buried) and are solid only where their crates are; the pillars' footprints are as built.

steps.title: Faster frames
steps.text: The people's whereabouts kept current at every change instead of recounted (by the station 464 -> 828 fps); the port's walking bounds by cells; a new game's map and a system's traders built a few a frame; lazy far life on planets.

steps.title: Fixes
steps.text: No crash on closing the game (background tasks collected before the pool shuts down); you can jump at high frame rates again (the ground's snap no longer catches a jump's first frames); the camera keeps following when a part it knew is gone.

+# A long cloth panel (a coat's tail) hangs on a chain of bones - name, name.2, name.3 ... end to end, each under the

+def chain(name, parent, head, lengths, d=(0, 0, -1), hint=(0, -1, 0)):
+    """A cloth chain's bones (EXTRA_BONES entries): `lengths` segments from `head` along d."""
+    out = {}
+    h = Vector(head)
+    for k, ln in enumerate(lengths):
+        out[name if k == 0 else "%s.%d" % (name, k + 1)] = (parent, tuple(h), tuple(d), tuple(hint), ln)
+        h = h + Vector(d).normalized() * ln

+## children, who grow up and find work of their own; save their wages - a

+## some enlist and sail with the fleets (Fleets) - and a fleet's ships lost
+## are its sailors lost, mourned at home; the old die. Each keeps a short log
+## of what happened to them (`log`), which they tell you about.
+## The state is saved with the galaxy (Galaxy.get_save_data: "people").
+
+const DAY := 120.0                 # s of play: a day of their lives (shifts turn over three times in it)
+const YEAR := 2400.0               # s of play: a year of their ages
+const LIFE_TICK := 20.0            # each one's life looked at this often (s)
+const ADULT := 17.0
+## A station's staff: [job, how many].
+const STAFF := [["bartender", 1], ["officer", 2], ["guard", 2], ["dock", 2], ["carrier", 2]]
+const CREW_MAX := 3                # a trader's crew besides its captain
+const SHIP_PRICE := 9000           # dr: a crew member who has saved this much buys a ship of their own
+const WAGE := {"bartender": 40, "officer": 60, "guard": 50, "dock": 40, "carrier": 35, "crew": 55, "captain": 0, "navy": 45, "": 0,
+	"farmer": 30, "fisher": 30, "potter": 35, "smith": 45, "weaver": 35, "scribe": 45, "priest": 40, "merchant": 60, "builder": 40}
+const JOB_NAMES := {"bartender": "bartender", "officer": "harbour officer", "guard": "port guard", "dock": "dock worker",
+	"carrier": "cargo hand", "crew": "crew", "captain": "captain", "navy": "sailor", "": "at home",
+	"farmer": "farmer", "fisher": "fisher", "potter": "potter", "smith": "smith", "weaver": "weaver", "scribe": "scribe",
+	"priest": "priest", "merchant": "merchant", "builder": "builder"}
+## A town's trades.
+const TOWN_JOBS := ["farmer", "farmer", "fisher", "potter", "smith", "weaver", "scribe", "priest", "merchant", "builder"]
+const GIVEN := ["Alkmene", "Ariston", "Damon", "Eudora", "Glaukos", "Hermione", "Iason", "Kallias", "Lysandra", "Melitta", "Nikias",
+	"Phaidra", "Philon", "Rhode", "Sostratos", "Thais", "Timon", "Xanthe", "Zenon", "Kleio", "Myron", "Ione", "Teukros", "Eirene",
+	"Aristeia", "Demetrios", "Eurydike", "Hippias", "Kallisto", "Leandros", "Menon", "Nausikaa", "Orestes", "Pherenike", "Stratonike",
+	"Thrasyllos", "Agathe", "Bion", "Chloe", "Dion", "Elpis", "Gorgo", "Hagnon", "Isadora", "Korinna", "Lykos", "Melanthios", "Neaira",
+	"Pasion", "Sappho", "Telesilla", "Xenon", "Ampelis", "Charmides", "Daphne", "Euphranor", "Ianthe", "Kimon", "Lampito", "Phokion"]
+const FAMILY := ["Akamantides", "Alkmeonides", "Boutadai", "Charopides", "Eteoboutadai", "Philaides", "Kerykes", "Eumolpidai",
+	"Lykomidai", "Phytalidai", "Gephyraioi", "Iamidai", "Klytiadai", "Bakchiadai", "Kypselidai", "Orthagoridai", "Aiakidai",
+	"Neleidai", "Pelopidai", "Minyades", "Kodridai", "Medontidai", "Penthilidai", "Aleuadai", "Skopadai", "Echekratidai",
+	"Damarchidai", "Thalassioi", "Karpathioi", "Phaistioi"]
+
+var persons := {}                  # id -> record (see _new)
+var _next := 1
+var _rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+var _ids: Array = []
+var _cursor := 0
+var _at := {}                      # id -> Galaxy time its life was last looked at
+## (kept current at every change - nothing ever counts everyone) who goes with whom:
+## "crew:<tid>" -> {id: true} a ship's captain and crew, "fleet:<fid>" -> its
+## sailors, a home ("st:<sid>", "town:<key>") -> the rest of those who live there.
+var _by := {}
+var _fleet_size := {}              # fleet id -> its size when last looked at (its losses: its sailors lost)
+var _sync_t := 0.0
+var populated := false
+var _start_n := 3000               # (alive when the sector was peopled: births grow rarer past a quarter more)
+var _alive_n := 3000
+
+
+func reset() -> void:
+	persons = {}
+	_next = 1
+	_ids = []
+	_cursor = 0
+	_at = {}
+	_fleet_size = {}
+	_by = {}
+	_known_traders = {}
+	populated = false
+	_rng.seed = 7
+
+
+# --- A new galaxy's people -------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## Everyone for a new game: each station's staff and their households; each
+## trader's captain and crew; each fleet's sailors.
+func populate() -> void:
+	reset()
+	for sid in Galaxy.stations:
+		_staff_station(str(sid))
+	for tid in Galaxy.traders:
+		crew_trader(str(tid), true)
+	_finish_populate()
+
+
+## The same a little a frame (a new game from the title: the loading screen keeps moving).
+func populate_async(budget_us := 4000) -> void:
+	reset()
+	var t0 := Time.get_ticks_usec()
+	for sid in Galaxy.stations:
+		_staff_station(str(sid))
+		if Time.get_ticks_usec() - t0 > budget_us:
+			await get_tree().process_frame
+			t0 = Time.get_ticks_usec()
+	for tid in Galaxy.traders:
+		crew_trader(str(tid), true)
+		if Time.get_ticks_usec() - t0 > budget_us:
+			await get_tree().process_frame
+			t0 = Time.get_ticks_usec()
+	_finish_populate()
+
+
+func _finish_populate() -> void:
+	_sync_fleets()
+	_start_n = persons.size()
+	_alive_n = _start_n
+	populated = true
+
+
+func _staff_station(sid: String) -> void:
+	var emp := Galaxy.station_owner(sid)
+	for s in STAFF:
+		for k in int(s[1]):
+			var p := _new(emp, "st:" + sid, str(s[0]), sid, _rng.randf_range(20.0, 62.0))
+			# (a household: a partner at home, children - some of them)
+			if _rng.randf() < 0.45:
+				var q := _new(emp, "st:" + sid, "", "", clampf(float(p["age"]) + _rng.randf_range(-6.0, 6.0), 19.0, 70.0), str(p["f"]))
+				_pair(p, q)
+				for c in _rng.randi_range(0, 2) if float(p["age"]) < 50.0 else 0:
+					var kid := _new(emp, "st:" + sid, "", "", _rng.randf_range(1.0, 15.0), str(p["f"]))
+					_child(kid, p, q)
+
+
+## A trader's captain (its owner) and crew - new hands for a new ship.
+func crew_trader(tid: String, fresh := false) -> void:
+	var r: Dictionary = Galaxy.traders.get(tid, {})
+	if r.is_empty():
+		return
+	var emp := str(r.get("empire", ""))
+	var home := "st:" + str(r.get("station", ""))
+	if r.get("captain", "") == "" or not persons.has(str(r.get("captain", ""))):
+		var c := _new(emp, home, "captain", tid, _rng.randf_range(28.0, 64.0))
+		c["ship"] = tid
+		r["captain"] = c["id"]
+		_log(c, "Captain of the %s" % r["name"])
+	for k in _rng.randi_range(1, CREW_MAX) - (1 if fresh else crew_of(tid).size()) + 1:
+		var m := _new(emp, home, "crew", tid, _rng.randf_range(18.0, 55.0))
+		_log(m, "Signed on to the %s" % r["name"])
+
+
+func _new(emp: String, home: String, job: String, at: String, age: float, family := "") -> Dictionary:
+	var id := "p%d" % _next
+	_next += 1
+	var p := {"id": id, "n": GIVEN[_rng.randi() % GIVEN.size()], "f": family if family != "" else FAMILY[_rng.randi() % FAMILY.size()],
+		"age": snappedf(age, 0.1), "emp": emp, "home": home, "job": job, "at": at, "money": _rng.randi_range(100, 3000),
+		"ship": "", "partner": "", "kids": [], "parents": [], "friends": [], "alive": true, "log": [], "born": Galaxy.time - age * YEAR}
+	persons[id] = p
+	_file(p, true)
+	return p
+
+
+func _pair(a: Dictionary, b: Dictionary) -> void:
+	a["partner"] = b["id"]
+	b["partner"] = a["id"]
+	_log(a, "Partnered with %s" % full_name(b))
+	_log(b, "Partnered with %s" % full_name(a))
+
+
+func _child(kid: Dictionary, a: Dictionary, b: Dictionary) -> void:
+	kid["parents"] = [a["id"], b["id"]]
+	a["kids"].append(kid["id"])
+	b["kids"].append(kid["id"])
+
+
+func _log(p: Dictionary, text: String) -> void:
+	var l: Array = p["log"]
+	l.append([snappedf(Galaxy.time, 1.0), text])
+	if l.size() > 10:
+		l.pop_front()
+
+
+# --- The towns' people ------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## A town's people (`key`: its planet and its name), made the first time
+## anyone comes near it - households, each with a house of its own and a
+## trade - then living on like everyone else. Its grown-ups' ids.
+func town_folk(key: String, emp: String, city: bool) -> Array:
+	var home := "town:" + key
+	if not _by.has(home):
+		var r := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+		r.seed = hash(key)
+		for h in (12 if city else 6):
+			var fam: String = FAMILY[r.randi() % FAMILY.size()]
+			var a := _new(emp, home, TOWN_JOBS[r.randi() % TOWN_JOBS.size()], key, r.randf_range(20.0, 66.0), fam)
+			a["house"] = h + 1
+			_log(a, "Lives at house %d, %s" % [h + 1, key.get_slice(":", 1)])
+			if r.randf() < 0.6:
+				var b := _new(emp, home, TOWN_JOBS[r.randi() % TOWN_JOBS.size()] if r.randf() < 0.6 else "", key, clampf(float(a["age"]) + r.randf_range(-6.0, 6.0), 19.0, 72.0), fam)
+				b["house"] = h + 1
+				_pair(a, b)
+				for c in r.randi_range(0, 3) if float(a["age"]) < 52.0 else 0:
+					var kid := _new(emp, home, "", "", r.randf_range(1.0, 16.0), fam)
+					kid["house"] = h + 1
+					_child(kid, a, b)
+	return _group(home).filter(func(i): return float(persons[i]["age"]) >= ADULT)
+
+
+# --- Who and where -----------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func person(id: String) -> Dictionary:
+	return persons.get(id, {})
+
+
+func full_name(p: Dictionary) -> String:
+	return "%s %s" % [p["n"], p["f"]] if not p.is_empty() else "?"
+
+
+func job_name(p: Dictionary) -> String:
+	if p.is_empty():
+		return ""
+	if float(p["age"]) < ADULT:
+		return "child"
+	return str(JOB_NAMES.get(p["job"], p["job"]))
+
+
+## Where `p` is now: "st:<sid>" (at a station: its staff and household, a docked
+## ship's people), "ship:<tid>" (aboard, travelling), "fleet:<fid>".
+func where(p: Dictionary) -> String:
+	match str(p["job"]):
+		"crew", "captain":
+			var r: Dictionary = Galaxy.traders.get(str(p["at"]), {})
+			if r.is_empty():
+				return str(p["home"])
+			return "st:" + str(r["station"]) if r["state"] == "docked" else "ship:" + str(r["id"])
+		"navy":
+			return "fleet:" + str(p["at"])
+	return str(p["home"])
+
+
+## On duty now (a station's staff: shifts of a third of a day, two of three worked).
+func on_shift(p: Dictionary) -> bool:
+	if not p["job"] in ["bartender", "officer", "guard", "dock", "carrier"]:
+		return false
+	return (int(Galaxy.time / (DAY / 3.0)) + absi(hash(p["id"]))) % 3 != 0
+
+
+## (Kept for callers: where everyone is follows from their ships' records, nothing to recount.)
+func mark() -> void:
+	pass
+
+
+## Which group `p` is filed under (see _by).
+func _key(p: Dictionary) -> String:
+	match str(p["job"]):
+		"crew", "captain":
+			return "crew:" + str(p["at"])
+		"navy":
+			return "fleet:" + str(p["at"])
+	return str(p["home"])
+
+
+func _file(p: Dictionary, on: bool) -> void:
+	var k := _key(p)
+	if on:
+		if not _by.has(k):
+			_by[k] = {}
+		_by[k][p["id"]] = true
+	elif _by.has(k):
+		(_by[k] as Dictionary).erase(p["id"])
+		if (_by[k] as Dictionary).is_empty():
+			_by.erase(k)
+
+
+## A new job, post or home for `p` - every change of them through here (filed anew).
+func _move(p: Dictionary, job: String, at: String, home := "") -> void:
+	_file(p, false)
+	p["job"] = job
+	p["at"] = at
+	if home != "":
+		p["home"] = home
+	if p["alive"]:
+		_file(p, true)
+
+
+func _group(k: String) -> Array:
+	return (_by.get(k, {}) as Dictionary).keys()
+
+
+func _refile() -> void:
+	_by = {}
+	for id in persons:
+		if persons[id]["alive"]:
+			_file(persons[id], true)
+
+
+## A trader's people: its captain first, then its crew.
+func crew_of(tid: String) -> Array:
+	var out: Array = []
+	for id in _group("crew:" + tid):
+		if persons[id]["job"] == "captain":
+			out.push_front(id)
+		else:
+			out.append(id)
+	return out
+
+
+## Everyone at station `sid` now: its staff and households, the people of the ships docked there.
+func at_station(sid: String) -> Array:
+	var out := _group("st:" + sid)
+	for tid in Galaxy.traders:
+		var r: Dictionary = Galaxy.traders[tid]
+		if r["state"] == "docked" and str(r["station"]) == sid:
+			out.append_array(_group("crew:" + str(tid)))
+	return out
+
+
+# --- Their lives -------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	if not populated or not Galaxy.active:
+		return
+	_sync_t -= delta
+	if _sync_t <= 0.0:
+		_sync_t = 5.0
+		_sync_traders()
+		_sync_fleets()
+	if _cursor >= _ids.size():
+		_ids = persons.keys()
+		_cursor = 0
+	# (a share of them a frame, by time: everyone looked at every LIFE_TICK s)
+	var share := mini(maxi(1, ceili(_ids.size() * delta / LIFE_TICK)), 40)
+	var end := mini(_cursor + share, _ids.size())
+	for j in range(_cursor, end):
+		var p: Dictionary = persons.get(_ids[j], {})
+		if p.is_empty() or not p["alive"]:
+			continue
+		var dt := clampf(Galaxy.time - float(_at.get(p["id"], Galaxy.time - LIFE_TICK)), 0.0, 600.0)
+		_at[p["id"]] = Galaxy.time
+		_live(p, dt)
+	_cursor = end
+
+
+func _live(p: Dictionary, dt: float) -> void:
+	var was_child := float(p["age"]) < ADULT
+	p["age"] = snappedf(float(p["age"]) + dt / YEAR, 0.01)
+	if was_child and float(p["age"]) >= ADULT:
+		_log(p, "Came of age")
+	if float(p["age"]) > 70.0 and _rng.randf() < (float(p["age"]) - 70.0) * 0.0004 * dt / LIFE_TICK:
+		_die(p, "Died of old age")
+		return
+	if float(p["age"]) < ADULT:
+		return
+	p["money"] = int(p["money"]) + int(float(WAGE.get(p["job"], 0)) * dt / DAY) - int(12.0 * dt / DAY)
+	var mates := _group(_key(p))
+	# Friends: of the people they work and live with.
+	if mates.size() > 1 and (p["friends"] as Array).size() < 6 and _rng.randf() < 0.03 * dt / LIFE_TICK:
+		var q: Dictionary = persons.get(mates[_rng.randi() % mates.size()], {})
+		if not q.is_empty() and q["id"] != p["id"] and float(q["age"]) >= ADULT and not q["id"] in p["friends"]:
+			p["friends"].append(q["id"])
+			q["friends"].append(p["id"])
+			_log(p, "Became friends with %s" % full_name(q))
+			_log(q, "Became friends with %s" % full_name(p))
+	# A partner: one of their friends.
+	if p["partner"] == "" and float(p["age"]) < 60.0 and _rng.randf() < 0.0015 * dt / LIFE_TICK:
+		for fid in p["friends"]:
+			var q: Dictionary = persons.get(fid, {})
+			if not q.is_empty() and q["alive"] and q["partner"] == "" and absf(float(q["age"]) - float(p["age"])) < 14.0:
+				_pair(p, q)
+				if p["job"] == "" or (p["job"] in WAGE and q["job"] in ["bartender", "officer", "guard", "dock", "carrier"]):
+					_move(p, str(p["job"]), str(p["at"]), str(q["home"]))   # (moves in)
+				break
+	# Children.
+	if p["partner"] != "" and float(p["age"]) < 45.0 and (p["kids"] as Array).size() < 3 and _alive_n < _start_n * 1.25 \
+			and _rng.randf() < 0.0006 * dt / LIFE_TICK:   # (rarely - and fewer as the sector fills)
+		var q: Dictionary = persons.get(p["partner"], {})
+		if not q.is_empty() and q["alive"]:
+			var kid := _new(str(p["emp"]), str(p["home"]), "", "", 0.0, str(p["f"]))
+			_child(kid, p, q)
+			_log(p, "A child: %s" % kid["n"])
+			_log(q, "A child: %s" % kid["n"])
+	# Work: the jobless look for it.
+	if p["job"] == "":
+		_find_work(p)
+	elif p["job"] == "crew" and int(p["money"]) >= SHIP_PRICE and _rng.randf() < 0.05:
+		_buy_ship(p)
+	elif p["job"] != "navy" and p["job"] != "captain" and p["partner"] == "" and _at_war(str(p["emp"])) and _rng.randf() < 0.002 * dt / LIFE_TICK:
+		_enlist(p)
+
+
+func _at_war(e: String) -> bool:
+	for o in Galaxy.MAJOR:
+		if o != e and Galaxy.at_war(e, o):
+			return true
+	return false
+
+
+## A job for one who has none: a vacancy at their station, else a berth on a
+## ship there, else (at war) the navy.
+func _find_work(p: Dictionary) -> void:
+	var home := str(p["home"])
+	if home.begins_with("town:"):   # (a town's grown children: a trade of their own)
+		_move(p, TOWN_JOBS[_rng.randi() % TOWN_JOBS.size()], home.substr(5))
+		_log(p, "Took up work as a %s" % JOB_NAMES[p["job"]])
+		return
+	if not home.begins_with("st:"):
+		return
+	var sid := home.substr(3)
+	if not Galaxy.stations.has(sid):
+		return
+	var staff: Dictionary = {}
+	for id in _group(home):
+		var q: Dictionary = persons[id]
+		if q["at"] == sid:
+			staff[q["job"]] = int(staff.get(q["job"], 0)) + 1
+	for s in STAFF:
+		if int(staff.get(s[0], 0)) < int(s[1]):
+			_move(p, str(s[0]), sid)
+			_log(p, "Took work as a %s at %s" % [JOB_NAMES[s[0]], Galaxy.stations[sid]["name"]])
+			return
+	for tid in Galaxy.traders:
+		var r: Dictionary = Galaxy.traders[tid]
+		if r["state"] == "docked" and str(r["station"]) == sid and (_by.get("crew:" + str(tid), {}) as Dictionary).size() <= CREW_MAX:
+			_move(p, "crew", str(tid))
+			_log(p, "Signed on to the %s" % r["name"])
+			return
+	if _at_war(str(p["emp"])) and _rng.randf() < 0.3:
+		_enlist(p)
+
+
+func _enlist(p: Dictionary) -> void:
+	var fl: Array = Fleets.fleets.values().filter(func(f): return f["empire"] == p["emp"])
+	if fl.is_empty():
+		return
+	var f: Dictionary = fl[_rng.randi() % fl.size()]
+	_move(p, "navy", str(f["id"]))
+	_log(p, "Enlisted in the %s's navy" % Galaxy.empire_name(str(p["emp"])))
+
+
+## Their savings on a ship of their own: a new trader at their ship's port, its captain.
+func _buy_ship(p: Dictionary) -> void:
+	var r: Dictionary = Galaxy.traders.get(str(p["at"]), {})
+	if r.is_empty() or r["state"] != "docked":
+		return
+	var t: Dictionary = Galaxy.spawn_trader(str(r["station"]))
+	if t.is_empty():
+		return
+	p["money"] = int(p["money"]) - SHIP_PRICE
+	_move(p, "captain", str(t["id"]))
+	p["ship"] = t["id"]
+	t["captain"] = p["id"]
+	t["empire"] = p["emp"] if p["emp"] != "" else t["empire"]
+	_log(p, "Bought a ship of their own: the %s" % t["name"])
+	crew_trader(str(t["id"]))
+
+
+func _die(p: Dictionary, why: String) -> void:
+	if not p["alive"]:
+		return
+	_file(p, false)
+	p["alive"] = false
+	_log(p, why)
+	for k in ["partner"]:
+		var q: Dictionary = persons.get(str(p[k]), {})
+		if not q.is_empty() and q["alive"]:
+			_log(q, "Lost their partner, %s" % full_name(p))
+			q["partner"] = ""
+	for kid in p["kids"]:
+		var q: Dictionary = persons.get(kid, {})
+		if not q.is_empty() and q["alive"]:
+			_log(q, "Lost a parent, %s" % full_name(p))
+	for par in p["parents"]:
+		var q: Dictionary = persons.get(par, {})
+		if not q.is_empty() and q["alive"]:
+			_log(q, "Lost a child, %s" % full_name(p))
+	if p["job"] == "captain":   # (the ship to its first mate - or laid up)
+		var crew := crew_of(str(p["at"]))
+		crew.erase(p["id"])
+		if not crew.is_empty():
+			var mate: Dictionary = persons[crew[0]]
+			_move(mate, "captain", str(p["at"]))
+			mate["ship"] = p["at"]
+			Galaxy.traders.get(str(p["at"]), {})["captain"] = mate["id"]
+			_log(mate, "Took command of the %s" % Galaxy.traders.get(str(p["at"]), {}).get("name", "ship"))
+
+
+## A trader destroyed (in your system: you saw it): its captain and crew with it.
+func ship_lost(tid: String, why: String) -> void:
+	for id in crew_of(tid):

+class_name Map3DView
+extends Control
+## A 3D map in a page of the Ship Computer (the solar map, the galaxy map -
+## each a subclass): its own little 3D world in a SubViewport (MapKit's
+## parts), seen by a camera that orbits a focus point, and drawn here as a
+## picture with the markers and names over it (projected from 3D).
+##
+## Mouse: drag to rotate, right / middle drag (or Shift + drag) to pan, the
+## wheel zooms toward the cursor, a click selects (pick), a double click
+## flies to what's under it, a middle click fits everything (fit()).
+## Keys / pad (while its page shows): WASD / arrows / D-pad / left stick
+## rotate, the right stick pans, + / - / PageUp / PageDown / the triggers
+## zoom, Home fits, Enter / Space / A plot a course to the selection
+## (accept()), Backspace / X selects the next thing (cycle()).
+## The camera eases to where it's sent. The 3D picture is drawn again when the
+## view moves or what it shows changes, else `anim_hz` a second (its lines
+## flow, its rings pulse); the overlay (markers, names: the costly part,
+## drawn by script) when the view moves, else `overlay_hz` a second.
+
+signal selected(key: String)
+
+const BG := Color(0.012, 0.012, 0.022)
+
+var vp: SubViewport
+var cam: Camera3D
+var world: Node3D               # what the subclass shows (its 3D parts)
+var focus := Vector3.ZERO
+var yaw := 0.7
+var pitch := -0.62              # (radians: negative looks down)
+var dist := 300.0
+var min_dist := 1.0
+var max_dist := 20000.0
+var anim_hz := 30.0             # (the 3D picture while the view rests: the lines' flow, the rings' pulse)
+var overlay_hz := 8.0           # (the markers and names over it while it rests)
+var selected_key := ""
+var hover_key := ""
+## The things on the map that can be picked: key -> {pos (Vector3), r (px)}
+## - the subclass fills it (and the overlay draws them).
+var marks := {}
+
+var _focus_t := Vector3.ZERO
+var _yaw_t := 0.7
+var _pitch_t := -0.62
+var _dist_t := 300.0
+var _dirty := true
+var _press := Vector2.ZERO
+var _drag := ""                 # "", "rotate", "pan"
+var _moved := false
+var _drawn_at := 0              # (when the overlay was last drawn, usec)
+var _overlay_due := false
+var _screen := {}               # key -> where it is on the screen (this picture)
+var _behind := {}               # key -> true: behind the camera
+
+
+func _init() -> void:
+	mouse_filter = MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
+	clip_contents = true
+	vp = SubViewport.new()
+	vp.own_world_3d = true
+	vp.transparent_bg = false
+	vp.msaa_3d = Viewport.MSAA_2X
+	vp.render_target_update_mode = SubViewport.UPDATE_DISABLED
+	vp.size = Vector2i(64, 64)
+	vp.positional_shadow_atlas_size = 0
+	var env := Environment.new()
+	env.background_mode = Environment.BG_COLOR
+	env.background_color = BG
+	env.ambient_light_source = Environment.AMBIENT_SOURCE_DISABLED
+	env.reflected_light_source = Environment.REFLECTION_SOURCE_DISABLED
+	env.tonemap_mode = Environment.TONE_MAPPER_LINEAR
+	var we := WorldEnvironment.new()
+	we.environment = env
+	vp.add_child(we)
+	cam = Camera3D.new()
+	cam.fov = 50.0
+	cam.near = 0.05
+	cam.far = 200000.0
+	vp.add_child(cam)
+	world = Node3D.new()
+	vp.add_child(world)
+	add_child(vp)

+
+## Sends the camera (eased) to look at `at` from `d` away (keeping its turn).
+func fly_to(at: Vector3, d := -1.0) -> void:
+	_focus_t = at
+	if d > 0.0:
+		_dist_t = clampf(d, min_dist, max_dist)
+
+
+## Puts the camera there at once (no easing).
+func snap_to(at: Vector3, d: float) -> void:
+	_focus_t = at
+	focus = at
+	_dist_t = clampf(d, min_dist, max_dist)
+	dist = _dist_t
+	_dirty = true
+
+
+## Shows the box round `pts` (eased; `now`: at once).
+func fit_points(pts: Array, now := false) -> void:
+	if pts.is_empty():
+		return
+	var box := AABB(pts[0], Vector3.ZERO)
+	for p in pts:
+		box = box.expand(p)
+	var r := maxf(box.size.length() * 0.5, min_dist * 2.0)
+	var d := r / tan(deg_to_rad(cam.fov) * 0.5) * 0.85
+	if size.x > 1.0 and size.y > 1.0 and size.x < size.y:
+		d *= size.y / size.x

+		snap_to(box.get_center(), d)

+		yaw = lerpf(yaw, _yaw_t, k)
+		pitch = lerpf(pitch, _pitch_t, k)
+		dist = exp(lerpf(log(dist), log(_dist_t), k))

+	if moving or _dirty:

+			_drawn_at = now

+		else:

+## (The subclass: the camera moved - sizes kept on the screen follow.)

+## Where a mark is on the screen (null: behind the camera).

+
+## Where a point is on the screen (null: behind the camera).
+func project(p: Vector3) -> Variant:

+		if d < r and d < bd:

+
+
+static var _widths := {}        # (names' widths, measured once)
+

+func tag(at: Vector2, text: String, fs: int, col: Color, taken: Array, font: Font = null, centred := true) -> bool:

+	if w < 0.0:

+
+## Zoom by `f` (under 1: in) toward the screen point `at`.
+func zoom(f: float, at := Vector2(-1, -1)) -> void:
+	var nd := clampf(_dist_t * f, min_dist, max_dist)
+	f = nd / _dist_t
+	if at.x >= 0.0 and f < 1.0:
+		var p := cam.project_position(at, dist)
+		_focus_t += (p - _focus_t) * (1.0 - f) * 0.9
+	_dist_t = nd
+
+
+## Pans by a screen motion (px).
+func pan(rel: Vector2) -> void:
+	var k := 2.0 * _dist_t * tan(deg_to_rad(cam.fov) * 0.5) / maxf(size.y, 1.0)
+	var right := cam.global_basis.x
+	var up := cam.global_basis.y
+	_focus_t += (-right * rel.x + up * rel.y) * k
+
+
+## (The subclass: a click on `key` ("": empty space); Shift held: `add`.)
+func clicked(key: String, _add: bool) -> void:
+	if key != "":
+		select(key)
+
+
+## (The subclass: a right click.)
+func right_clicked(_key: String) -> void:
+	pass
+
+
+func select(key: String) -> void:
+	selected_key = key
+	_dirty = true
+	selected.emit(key)
+
+
+## (The subclass: Enter / A - plot a course to the selection.)
+func accept() -> void:
+	pass
+
+
+## The next mark after the selection (Backspace / X): in the order of
+## cycle_order() (the subclass's), nearest first.
+func cycle(d := 1) -> void:
+	var keys := cycle_order()
+	if keys.is_empty():
+		return
+	var i := keys.find(selected_key)
+	var k: String = keys[wrapi(i + d, 0, keys.size())] if i >= 0 else keys[0]
+	select(k)
+	fly_to(marks[k]["pos"])
+
+
+func cycle_order() -> Array:
+	return marks.keys()
+
+
+## Is this map the one the keys and the pad drive (its page on top)?
+func _driving() -> bool:
+	if not is_visible_in_tree() or UI.esc_menu_open():
+		return false
+	var m := Keybinds.active_menu()
+	if m != null and not m.is_ancestor_of(self):
+		return false
+	var f := get_viewport().gui_get_focus_owner()
+	return not (f is LineEdit or f is TextEdit)
+
+
+func _input(ev: InputEvent) -> void:
+	if not _driving():
+		return
+	if ev is InputEventKey and (ev as InputEventKey).pressed:
+		match (ev as InputEventKey).keycode:
+			KEY_HOME:
+				fit()
+				get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
+				return
+	for a in ["menu_up", "menu_down", "menu_left", "menu_right"]:
+		if Keybinds.pressed_repeat(ev, a):
+			get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()   # (they turn the map - not the focus round the page)
+			return
+	if Keybinds.pressed(ev, "menu_accept"):
+		accept()
+		get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
+	elif Keybinds.pressed(ev, "menu_secondary"):
+		cycle()
+		get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
+
+
+## The held keys and the pad's sticks, each frame.
+func _controls(delta: float) -> void:
+	if not _driving():
+		return
+	var turn := Vector2(Input.get_action_strength("menu_right") - Input.get_action_strength("menu_left"),
+		Input.get_action_strength("menu_down") - Input.get_action_strength("menu_up"))
+	var pan_v := Vector2.ZERO
+	var z := 0.0
+	if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_EQUAL) or Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_KP_ADD) or Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_PAGEUP):
+		z -= 1.0
+	if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_MINUS) or Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_KP_SUBTRACT) or Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_PAGEDOWN):
+		z += 1.0
+	for dev in Input.get_connected_joypads():
+		var ls := Vector2(Input.get_joy_axis(dev, JOY_AXIS_LEFT_X), Input.get_joy_axis(dev, JOY_AXIS_LEFT_Y))
+		if ls.length() > Keybinds.DEADZONE:
+			turn += ls
+		var rs := Vector2(Input.get_joy_axis(dev, JOY_AXIS_RIGHT_X), Input.get_joy_axis(dev, JOY_AXIS_RIGHT_Y))
+		if rs.length() > Keybinds.DEADZONE:
+			pan_v += rs
+		z += Input.get_joy_axis(dev, JOY_AXIS_TRIGGER_LEFT) - Input.get_joy_axis(dev, JOY_AXIS_TRIGGER_RIGHT)
+	if turn != Vector2.ZERO:
+		_yaw_t -= turn.x * delta * 1.8
+		_pitch_t = clampf(_pitch_t + turn.y * delta * 1.3, -1.5, 1.5)
+	if pan_v != Vector2.ZERO:
+		pan(-pan_v * delta * 600.0)
+	if absf(z) > 0.1:
+		_dist_t = clampf(_dist_t * exp(z * delta * 1.6), min_dist, max_dist)

@@ -1,0 +1,235 @@ 
+class_name MapKit
+extends RefCounted
+## The 3D maps' parts (the Ship Computer's solar and galaxy maps - Map3DView):
+## their few shaders (shaders/maps/: lines, worlds, glows, the reference plane,
+## points) as shared materials, and the meshes made of them - lines as
+## screen-wide ribbons (Lines), soft glows by the hundred in one MultiMesh,
+## point clouds, one shared sphere. Every material is one of five shaders
+## (CosmosWarm draws each at the title: no compile hitch the first time a map
+## opens).
+
+const LINE := preload("res://shaders/maps/map_line.gdshader")
+const BODY := preload("res://shaders/maps/map_body.gdshader")
+const GLOW := preload("res://shaders/maps/map_glow.gdshader")
+const PLANE := preload("res://shaders/maps/map_plane.gdshader")
+const POINTS := preload("res://shaders/maps/map_points.gdshader")
+
+static var _line_mat: ShaderMaterial
+static var _glow_mat: ShaderMaterial
+static var _points_mat: ShaderMaterial
+static var _sphere: SphereMesh
+static var _quad: QuadMesh
+
+
+## The lines' material (one for every line of every map: colours, widths and
+## dashes are the vertices').
+static func line_material() -> ShaderMaterial:
+	if _line_mat == null:
+		_line_mat = ShaderMaterial.new()
+		_line_mat.shader = LINE
+		_line_mat.render_priority = 1   # (over the plane's haze)
+	return _line_mat
+
+
+static func glow_material() -> ShaderMaterial:
+	if _glow_mat == null:
+		_glow_mat = ShaderMaterial.new()
+		_glow_mat.shader = GLOW
+		_glow_mat.render_priority = 2
+	return _glow_mat
+
+
+static func points_material(size_px := 2.0) -> ShaderMaterial:
+	if _points_mat == null:
+		_points_mat = ShaderMaterial.new()
+		_points_mat.shader = POINTS
+	if is_equal_approx(size_px, 2.0):
+		return _points_mat
+	var m := _points_mat.duplicate() as ShaderMaterial
+	m.set_shader_parameter("size_px", size_px)
+	return m
+
+
+## A world's (or star's) material - its own (its colours are parameters).
+static func body_material(look: Dictionary, star := false) -> ShaderMaterial:
+	var m := ShaderMaterial.new()
+	m.shader = BODY
+	set_look(m, look, star)
+	return m
+
+
+## A world's look (PlanetGen's colours) as the body shader's parameters.
+static func set_look(m: ShaderMaterial, L: Dictionary, star := false) -> void:
+	if star:
+		m.set_shader_parameter("emit", 1.0)
+		m.set_shader_parameter("c_low", L.get("c_dark", Color(0.6, 0.3, 0.05)))
+		m.set_shader_parameter("c_mid", L.get("c_mid", Color(1.0, 0.75, 0.35)))
+		m.set_shader_parameter("c_high", L.get("c_hot", Color(1.0, 0.95, 0.8)))
+		return
+	var gas := int(L.get("mode", 0)) == 1 or L.has("gas_a")
+	m.set_shader_parameter("bands", 1.0 if gas else 0.0)
+	if gas:
+		m.set_shader_parameter("c_low", L.get("gas_a", L.get("color_dark", Color(0.5, 0.4, 0.3))))
+		m.set_shader_parameter("c_mid", L.get("gas_b", L.get("color_light", Color(0.8, 0.7, 0.5))))
+		m.set_shader_parameter("c_high", L.get("gas_c", Color(0.9, 0.85, 0.75)))
+	else:
+		var wet := L.has("water_deep")
+		m.set_shader_parameter("c_low", L.get("water_deep", L.get("land_low", L.get("color_dark", Color(0.3, 0.3, 0.3)))))
+		m.set_shader_parameter("c_mid", L.get("land_mid", L.get("color_light", Color(0.5, 0.5, 0.5))))
+		m.set_shader_parameter("c_high", L.get("ice_color", L.get("land_high", Color(0.8, 0.8, 0.8))))
+		m.set_shader_parameter("sea", clampf(float(L.get("water_level", 0.5)), 0.2, 0.7) if wet else 0.28)
+	m.set_shader_parameter("c_air", L.get("atmosphere", Color(0.5, 0.7, 1.0)))
+	m.set_shader_parameter("air", clampf(float(L.get("atmo_strength", 0.5)) * 1.2, 0.15, 0.9))
+	m.set_shader_parameter("seed", float(int(L.get("seed", 0)) % 97))
+
+
+## The reference plane's material (its own: grid colour, fog).
+static func plane_material() -> ShaderMaterial:
+	var m := ShaderMaterial.new()
+	m.shader = PLANE
+	m.set_shader_parameter("grid_col", NeonTheme.HEAD)
+	m.set_shader_parameter("haze_col", Color(0.0, 0.0, 0.0))
+	return m
+
+
+## The one sphere every world on the maps is (scaled).
+static func sphere() -> SphereMesh:
+	if _sphere == null:
+		_sphere = SphereMesh.new()
+		_sphere.radius = 1.0
+		_sphere.height = 2.0
+		_sphere.radial_segments = 48
+		_sphere.rings = 24
+	return _sphere
+
+
+static func quad() -> QuadMesh:
+	if _quad == null:
+		_quad = QuadMesh.new()
+		_quad.size = Vector2.ONE
+	return _quad
+
+
+## A MultiMesh of `n` glows (set each with set_glow).
+static func glows(n: int) -> MultiMeshInstance3D:
+	var mm := MultiMesh.new()
+	mm.transform_format = MultiMesh.TRANSFORM_3D
+	mm.use_colors = true
+	mm.use_custom_data = true
+	mm.mesh = quad()
+	mm.instance_count = n
+	var mi := MultiMeshInstance3D.new()
+	mi.multimesh = mm
+	mi.material_override = glow_material()
+	mi.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
+	mi.extra_cull_margin = 16384.0   # (its quads are turned and sized in the shader)
+	return mi
+
+
+## One glow: at `at`, `size` across in the world but at least `min_px` on the
+## screen, its core `core` bright.
+static func set_glow(mi: MultiMeshInstance3D, i: int, at: Vector3, size: float, col: Color, min_px := 10.0, core := 0.6) -> void:
+	mi.multimesh.set_instance_transform(i, Transform3D(Basis.from_scale(Vector3.ONE * size), at))
+	mi.multimesh.set_instance_color(i, col)
+	mi.multimesh.set_instance_custom_data(i, Color(min_px, core, 0.0, 0.0))
+
+
+## Ring kinds (the glow shader's): a marker's ring, one that pulses, an arc turning round.
+const RING := 1.0
+const PULSE := 2.0
+const TURNING := 3.0
+
+## One ring: `px` across on the screen (or `size` in the world, if bigger),
+## `thick` px thick.
+static func set_ring(mi: MultiMeshInstance3D, i: int, at: Vector3, px: float, col: Color, kind := RING, thick := 1.6, size := 0.0) -> void:
+	mi.multimesh.set_instance_transform(i, Transform3D(Basis.from_scale(Vector3.ONE * maxf(size, 0.0001)), at))
+	mi.multimesh.set_instance_color(i, col)
+	mi.multimesh.set_instance_custom_data(i, Color(px, 0.0, kind, thick))
+
+
+## A cloud of points (stars far off, an asteroid field's rocks): sizes as
+## multiples of the material's size_px.
+static func points(pts: PackedVector3Array, cols: PackedColorArray, sizes: PackedFloat32Array) -> ArrayMesh:
+	var uv := PackedVector2Array()
+	uv.resize(pts.size())
+	for i in pts.size():
+		uv[i] = Vector2(sizes[i] if i < sizes.size() else 1.0, 0.0)
+	var arr := []
+	arr.resize(Mesh.ARRAY_MAX)
+	arr[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX] = pts
+	arr[Mesh.ARRAY_COLOR] = cols
+	arr[Mesh.ARRAY_TEX_UV] = uv
+	var m := ArrayMesh.new()
+	if not pts.is_empty():
+		m.add_surface_from_arrays(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_POINTS, arr)
+	return m
+
+
+## Lines to draw (segments, polylines, circles), made into one mesh: each
+## segment a quad the line shader turns to the camera and widens to its
+## width in pixels. Colours, widths and dashes per segment.
+class Lines:
+	var verts := PackedVector3Array()
+	var other := PackedFloat32Array()     # (CUSTOM0: the other end, and the side)
+	var uv := PackedVector2Array()
+	var uv2 := PackedVector2Array()
+	var cols := PackedColorArray()
+	var idx := PackedInt32Array()
+
+	func is_empty() -> bool:
+		return verts.is_empty()
+
+	## A segment a-b, `width` px; `dash`: dashes along it (0: solid) flowing
+	## at `flow` dashes a second; `col_b`: its colour at b (a fade).
+	func seg(a: Vector3, b: Vector3, col: Color, width := 2.0, dash := 0.0, flow := 0.0, col_b: Variant = null) -> void:
+		var cb: Color = col if col_b == null else col_b
+		var n := verts.size()
+		for e in [[a, b, col, 0.0], [b, a, cb, 1.0]]:
+			for side in [1.0, -1.0]:
+				verts.append(e[0])
+				var off: float = side if e[3] == 0.0 else -side   # (seen from b the line runs back: its sides swap)
+				other.append_array([e[1].x, e[1].y, e[1].z, off])
+				uv.append(Vector2(e[3] * dash, width * side))
+				uv2.append(Vector2(1.0 if dash > 0.0 else 0.0, flow))
+				cols.append(e[2])
+		idx.append_array([n, n + 1, n + 2, n + 1, n + 3, n + 2])
+
+	## Through `pts` in turn (closed: back to the first).
+	func poly(pts: PackedVector3Array, col: Color, width := 2.0, closed := false, dash := 0.0) -> void:
+		var m := pts.size() if closed else pts.size() - 1
+		for i in m:
+			seg(pts[i], pts[(i + 1) % pts.size()], col, width, dash)
+
+	## A circle round `c` of radius r in the plane of `u` and `v` (unit axes).
+	func circle(c: Vector3, r: float, col: Color, width := 1.5, n := 96, u := Vector3.RIGHT, v := Vector3.BACK) -> void:
+		var pts := PackedVector3Array()
+		for i in n:
+			var a := TAU * i / n
+			pts.append(c + (u * cos(a) + v * sin(a)) * r)
+		poly(pts, col, width, true)
+
+	func mesh() -> ArrayMesh:
+		var m := ArrayMesh.new()
+		if verts.is_empty():
+			return m
+		var arr := []
+		arr.resize(Mesh.ARRAY_MAX)
+		arr[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX] = verts
+		arr[Mesh.ARRAY_CUSTOM0] = other
+		arr[Mesh.ARRAY_TEX_UV] = uv
+		arr[Mesh.ARRAY_TEX_UV2] = uv2
+		arr[Mesh.ARRAY_COLOR] = cols
+		arr[Mesh.ARRAY_INDEX] = idx
+		m.add_surface_from_arrays(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES, arr, [], {},
+			Mesh.ARRAY_CUSTOM_RGBA_FLOAT << Mesh.ARRAY_FORMAT_CUSTOM0_SHIFT)
+		return m
+
+	## Into `mi` (made if null), with the lines' material.
+	func into(mi: MeshInstance3D) -> MeshInstance3D:
+		if mi == null:
+			mi = MeshInstance3D.new()
+			mi.material_override = MapKit.line_material()
+			mi.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
+			mi.extra_cull_margin = 16384.0   # (widened in the shader)
+		mi.mesh = mesh()
+		return mi

+class_name CosmosSandbox
+extends Node
+## The sandbox's ways to make a living (a child of Cosmos): every city's people
+## by its landing field - the ore buyer (your pack's raw minerals for drachmas),
+## the courier's office (a package to carry to a town on another world or a
+## station: in your hands - set down, picked up - handed over there for its pay),
+## the local pilot (a ride for a fee: their ship comes down on the field, you
+## walk up its ramp, it flies you to a town on another world or a station); your
+## scanner (Z: the deposits round you and the places - towns, caves, dungeons,
+## pirate camps, lairs, armed foes - marked for a while); raiders' bounties as
+## vouchers, handed in at a station's harbour office. Their state rides in the
+## save (CosmosGame.extra: "package", "bounties").
+
+const ROLES := {"vendor": "ore buyer", "courier": "courier's office", "pilot": "local pilot"}
+const SCAN_TIME := 60.0          # s the scan's marks stay
+const SCAN_ORE := 600.0          # m: deposits found within this
+const SCAN_FAR := 14000.0        # m: places found within this
+const VENDOR_PAY := 1.5          # of a mineral's value (raw ore's worth more to a town than in a station's market)
+
+var cosmos: Cosmos
+var scan_marks: Array = []       # [world position (planet-local if planet), planet or null, label, kind, until]
+var scan_pulse := 0.0            # (the pulse's ring on the HUD: 1 -> 0)
+var _box: Node3D                 # the package set down
+var _box_deck: Node3D            # (on a deck: the port, a ship's insides) or null (the ground)
+var _box_pl: CosmosPlanet
+var _box_at := Vector3.ZERO      # deck-local or planet-local
+var _ride: CosmosNpcShip         # the ride you hired, on its way or waiting
+
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	scan_pulse = maxf(0.0, scan_pulse - delta)
+	var now := Time.get_ticks_msec() / 1000.0
+	if not scan_marks.is_empty() and float(scan_marks[0][4]) < now:
+		scan_marks = scan_marks.filter(func(m): return float(m[4]) >= now)
+	if _box:   # (moved with its world or deck)
+		if _box_deck and is_instance_valid(_box_deck):
+			_box.global_transform = _box_deck.global_transform * Transform3D(Basis(), _box_at)
+		elif _box_pl and is_instance_valid(_box_pl):
+			var u := _box_at.normalized()
+			_box.global_transform = Transform3D(Basis.looking_at(u.cross(Vector3.RIGHT if absf(u.x) < 0.9 else Vector3.FORWARD), u), _box_pl.global_position + _box_at)
+		else:
+			_box.queue_free()
+			_box = null
+			holding(true)   # (its world gone: it's in your hands again)
+
+
+# --- Who's who by the field ------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## A city's people beside its landing field: [role, town-local spot] - where Kilon once stood.
+static func spots() -> Array:
+	return [["vendor", Vector3(-30.0, 0.0, -7.0)], ["courier", Vector3(-30.0, 0.0, 7.0)], ["pilot", Vector3(-12.0, 0.0, 22.0)]]
+
+
+func prompt_for(x: Node) -> Array:
+	return ["Talk to the %s" % ROLES[x.role], "svc:%d" % x.get_instance_id()]
+
+
+func talk(x: Node) -> void:
+	match str(x.role):
+		"vendor": _vendor(x)
+		"courier": _courier(x)
+		"pilot": _pilot(x)
+
+
+func _who(x: Node) -> String:
+	return "The %s" % ROLES.get(x.role, "townsman")
+
+
+func _bye(x: Node) -> Array:
+	return ["Farewell", func(): cosmos.converse([[_who(x), "Good roads to you."]], [])]
+
+
+# --- The ore buyer ------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func _ore_in_pack() -> Dictionary:
+	var out := {}
+	for id in Mining.MINERALS:
+		var n: int = CosmosGame.data.count(id)
+		if n > 0:
+			out[id] = n
+	return out
+
+
+static func ore_price(id: String) -> int:
+	return maxi(1, roundi(float(Items.info(id).get("value", 10)) * VENDOR_PAY))
+
+
+func _vendor(x: Node) -> void:
+	var ore := _ore_in_pack()
+	var total := 0
+	var units := 0
+	for id in ore:
+		total += ore_price(id) * int(ore[id])
+		units += int(ore[id])
+	var choices: Array = []
+	if units > 0:
+		choices.append(["Sell all my ore (%d units: %d dr)" % [units, total], func():
+			for id in ore:
+				CosmosGame.data.remove_item(id, int(ore[id]))
+			CosmosGame.data.add_credits(total)
+			cosmos.note_event("ore_sold")
+			cosmos.converse([[_who(x), "%d drachmas - counted out. Bring me more." % total]], [_bye(x)])])
+	choices.append(["What do you buy?", func():
+		var list: Array = []
+		for id in Mining.MINERALS:
+			list.append("%s %d" % [Items.info(id).get("name", id), ore_price(id)])
+		cosmos.converse([[_who(x), "Raw ore, dug or cut from the ground - your mining beam on a deposit (your scanner finds them). Per unit: " + ", ".join(list.slice(0, 8)) + "."]], [_bye(x)])])
+	choices.append(_bye(x))
+	cosmos.converse([[_who(x), "Ore buyer. I pay fair for what you dig." if units == 0 else "Let's see what you've brought - %d units." % units]], choices)
+
+
+# --- The courier's office: packages ------------------------------------------------------
+
+func package() -> Dictionary:
+	return CosmosGame.extra.get("package", {})
+
+
+## Your package in your hands (`on`): the walker carrying it.
+func holding(on: bool) -> void:
+	var w := cosmos.walker
+	if w:
+		w.set_carry(on and not package().is_empty())
+
+
+## Delivery jobs from town `t`: towns on the system's other worlds and its stations, a few, each its pay.
+func jobs_from(t: Node) -> Array:
+	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+	rng.seed = hash(str(t.site.get("name", "")) + str(int(Galaxy.time / 300.0)))   # (new ones every five minutes)
+	var all: Array = []
+	for pl: CosmosPlanet in cosmos.planets:
+		if pl == t.planet:
+			continue
+		for s in pl.towns:
+			all.append({"kind": "town", "planet": str(pl.rec.get("name", "")), "town": str(s["name"]), "label": "%s on %s" % [s["name"], pl.rec.get("name", "")],
+				"far": pl.global_position.distance_to(t.global_position)})
+	for st: CosmosStation in cosmos.stations:
+		all.append({"kind": "station", "id": str(st.record.get("id", "")), "label": cosmos.label_of(st), "far": st.global_position.distance_to(t.global_position)})
+	var out: Array = []
+	for i in mini(3, all.size()):
+		var j := rng.randi_range(0, all.size() - 1)
+		var d: Dictionary = all[j]
+		all.remove_at(j)
+		d["reward"] = 280 + roundi(clampf(float(d["far"]) / 1000.0, 0.0, 120.0)) + rng.randi_range(0, 60) + (40 if d["kind"] == "station" else 0)   # (~30 of them and the tutorial's rewards: a first ship, ~13,800 dr)
+		d["from"] = str(t.site.get("name", ""))
+		out.append(d)
+	return out
+
+
+func _courier(x: Node) -> void:
+	var p := package()
+	var here := str(x.town.site.get("name", ""))
+	var here_pl := str(x.town.planet.rec.get("name", ""))
+	var choices: Array = []
+	if not p.is_empty():
+		var dest: Dictionary = p["dest"]
+		if dest["kind"] == "town" and dest["town"] == here and dest["planet"] == here_pl:
+			if cosmos.walker and cosmos.walker.carrying:
+				choices.append(["Hand over the package (%d dr)" % int(p["reward"]), func(): _deliver(x, p)])
+			else:
+				cosmos.converse([[_who(x), "That's our package? Bring it here - I'll not fetch it off the ground."]], [_bye(x)])
+				return
+		else:
+			choices.append(["Give the package back (no pay)", func():
+				CosmosGame.extra.erase("package")
+				holding(false)
+				_clear_box()
+				cosmos.converse([[_who(x), "Back on the shelf it goes."]], [_bye(x)])])
+		choices.append(_bye(x))
+		cosmos.converse([[_who(x), "Yours is for %s. The local pilot by the field flies there - for a fee." % dest["label"]]], choices)
+		return
+	for j in jobs_from(x.town):
+		var job: Dictionary = j
+		choices.append(["A package for %s - %d dr" % [job["label"], int(job["reward"])], func(): _accept(x, job)])
+	choices.append(_bye(x))
+	cosmos.converse([[_who(x), "Couriers wanted - packages for the other worlds and the stations. You carry it, the pay's on delivery."]], choices)
+
+
+func _accept(x: Node, job: Dictionary) -> void:
+	CosmosGame.extra["package"] = {"dest": job, "reward": int(job["reward"]), "from": job["from"]}
+	if cosmos.walker:
+		cosmos.walker.hands("pick_up", func(): holding(true))
+	cosmos.note_event("package_taken")
+	cosmos.converse([[_who(x), "Here - mind it. For %s; the local pilot can fly you there. Set it down when you must (%s), but don't leave it." % [job["label"], Keybinds.keys_text("drop")]]], [])
+
+
+func _deliver(x: Node, p: Dictionary) -> void:
+	CosmosGame.extra.erase("package")
+	if cosmos.walker:
+		cosmos.walker.hands("put_down", func(): holding(false))
+	CosmosGame.data.add_credits(int(p["reward"]))
+	CosmosGame.extra["deliveries"] = int(CosmosGame.extra.get("deliveries", 0)) + 1
+	cosmos.note_event("package_delivered")
+	cosmos.converse([[_who(x) if x else "The harbour officer", "Signed for - %d drachmas. Come back for more." % int(p["reward"])]], [])
+
+
+## At a station's port: the harbour officer takes a package for this station, and bounty vouchers.
+func port_choices(role: String, who: String) -> Array:
+	var out: Array = []
+	if role != "officer":
+		return out
+	var p := package()
+	var st := cosmos.port_station()
+	if not p.is_empty() and st and p["dest"]["kind"] == "station" and str(p["dest"]["id"]) == str(st.record.get("id", "")):
+		if cosmos.walker and cosmos.walker.carrying:
+			out.append(["Hand over the package (%d dr)" % int(p["reward"]), func(): _deliver(null, p)])
+	var b := bounties()
+	if int(b.get("dr", 0)) > 0:
+		out.append(["Hand in my bounty vouchers (%d: %d dr)" % [int(b["n"]), int(b["dr"])], func():
+			CosmosGame.data.add_credits(int(b["dr"]))
+			CosmosGame.extra.erase("bounties")
+			cosmos.note_event("bounty_claimed")
+			cosmos.converse([[who, "%d drachmas from the empire's treasury - for the raiders. Good hunting." % int(b["dr"])]], [])])
+	return out
+
+
+# --- A package set down, picked up -----------------------------------------------------
+
+## H: the package out of your hands onto the ground (or the deck), or back into them.
+func drop_or_pick() -> void:
+	var w := cosmos.walker
+	if w == null or w.busy() or package().is_empty():
+		return
+	if w.carrying:
+		w.hands("put_down", func(): _set_down(w))
+	elif _box and _box.global_position.distance_to(w.global_position) < 2.2:
+		w.hands("pick_up", func():
+			_clear_box()
+			holding(true)
+			cosmos.note_event("box_up"))
+
+
+func box_near() -> bool:
+	var w := cosmos.walker
+	return w != null and _box != null and not w.carrying and _box.global_position.distance_to(w.global_position) < 2.2
+
+
+func _set_down(w: CosmosWalker) -> void:
+	w.set_carry(false)
+	cosmos.note_event("box_down")
+	_clear_box()
+	var c := MeshInstance3D.new()
+	c.mesh = EmpireKit.crate_mesh(true)
+	c.material_override = EmpireKit.mat("inside", "minoa")
+	c.scale = Vector3(0.33, 0.36, 0.25)
+	cosmos.world.add_child(c)
+	_box = c
+	var at := w.global_position + w.facing * 0.42
+	if w.deck:
+		_box_deck = w.deck
+		var l: Vector3 = w.deck.to_local(at)
+		l.y = float(w.deck.floor_y(l)) if w.deck.has_method("floor_y") else 0.0
+		_box_at = l
+	else:
+		_box_pl = w.planet
+		var local := at - w.planet.global_position
+		_box_at = local.normalized() * (w.planet.radius + w.floor_at(local))
+
+
+func _clear_box() -> void:
+	if _box:
+		_box.queue_free()
+	_box = null
+	_box_deck = null
+	_box_pl = null
+
+
+# --- The local pilot: rides ----------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## A town's landing field on `pl` (planet-local): level, x along it, on its deck.
+static func field_of(pl: CosmosPlanet, site: Dictionary) -> Transform3D:
+	var xf := CosmosTown.frame(site, pl.radius)
+	var half := 85.0 if str(site.get("kind", "")) == "city" else 45.0
+	return Transform3D(xf.basis, xf * Vector3(half + 38.0, 0.05, 0.0))
+
+
+func _fee(far: float) -> int:
+	return clampi(25 + roundi(far / 2500.0), 25, 140)
+
+
+func _pilot(x: Node) -> void:
+	if _ride and is_instance_valid(_ride):
+		cosmos.converse([[_who(x), "My ship's on the field for you - up the ramp when you're ready."]], [_bye(x)])
+		return
+	var t: Node = x.town
+	var dests: Array = []
+	var p := package()
+	if not p.is_empty():
+		dests.append(p["dest"])
+	for pl: CosmosPlanet in cosmos.planets:
+		if pl == t.planet or pl.towns.is_empty():
+			continue
+		for s in pl.towns:
+			if str(s.get("kind", "")) == "city":
+				dests.append({"kind": "town", "planet": str(pl.rec.get("name", "")), "town": str(s["name"]), "label": "%s on %s" % [s["name"], pl.rec.get("name", "")]})
+				break
+	for st: CosmosStation in cosmos.stations:
+		dests.append({"kind": "station", "id": str(st.record.get("id", "")), "label": cosmos.label_of(st)})
+	var seen := {}
+	var choices: Array = []
+	for d in dests:
+		var key := str(d["label"])
+		if seen.has(key) or choices.size() >= 6:
+			continue
+		seen[key] = true
+		var node := _dest_node(d)
+		if node == null:
+			continue
+		var fee := _fee(node.global_position.distance_to(t.global_position))
+		var dd: Dictionary = d
+		choices.append(["Fly me to %s - %d dr" % [d["label"], fee], func(): _hire(x, dd, fee)])
+	choices.append(_bye(x))
+	cosmos.converse([[_who(x), "Need a ride off-world? I fly to the other worlds' towns and the stations. Pay up front."]], choices)
+
+
+func _dest_node(d: Dictionary) -> Node3D:
+	if d["kind"] == "station":
+		return cosmos._station_by_id(str(d["id"]))
+	for pl: CosmosPlanet in cosmos.planets:
+		if str(pl.rec.get("name", "")) == str(d["planet"]):
+			return pl
+	return null
+
+
+func _hire(x: Node, d: Dictionary, fee: int) -> void:
+	if not CosmosGame.data.spend(fee):
+		cosmos.converse([[_who(x), "That's %d drachmas - come back when you have it." % fee]], [])
+		return
+	var t: Node = x.town
+	var to := {}
+	if d["kind"] == "station":
+		to = {"station": _dest_node(d)}
+	else:
+		var dpl: CosmosPlanet = _dest_node(d)
+		for s in dpl.towns:
+			if str(s["name"]) == str(d["town"]):
+				to = {"pl": dpl, "field": field_of(dpl, s)}
+	if to.is_empty():
+		CosmosGame.data.add_credits(fee)
+		return
+	var s := CosmosNpcShip.new()
+	s.setup("trader", cosmos, randi(), str(t.site.get("empire", "minoa")))
+	s.label = "The local pilot's ship"
+	cosmos.world.add_child(s)
+	cosmos.npc_ships.append(s)
+	s.hire_ride(t.planet, field_of(t.planet, t.site), to)
+	_ride = s
+	cosmos.note_event("ride_hired")
+	cosmos.converse([[_who(x), "Done. My ship's coming down on the field - walk up the ramp when it's down; I'll take you to %s." % d["label"]]], [])
+
+
+# --- The scanner -------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## Z on foot: a pulse out from you - the deposits near you, and the places further
+## off (towns, caves, dungeons, pirate camps, lairs, armed foes) marked for a minute.
+func scan() -> void:
+	var w := cosmos.walker
+	if w == null or w.deck != null or w.planet == null:
+		cosmos.hud.flash("The scanner works out on a world's ground")
+		return
+	var pl := w.planet
+	var me := w.global_position
+	var until := Time.get_ticks_msec() / 1000.0 + SCAN_TIME
+	scan_marks = []
+	scan_pulse = 1.0
+	var n_ore := 0
+	if cosmos.deposits and cosmos.deposits.planet == pl:
+		for k in cosmos.deposits.deps:
+			var dep: Dictionary = cosmos.deposits.deps[k]
+			var at: Vector3 = pl.global_position + (dep["at"] as Vector3)
+			if at.distance_to(me) < SCAN_ORE:
+				scan_marks.append([dep["at"], pl, "%s (%d)" % [Items.info(str(dep["mineral"])).get("name", dep["mineral"]), int(dep["units"])], "ore", until])
+				n_ore += 1
+	var places: Array = []
+	for s in pl.towns:
+		places.append([(s["dir"] as Vector3) * (pl.radius + float(s["h"])), "%s (%s)" % [s["name"], s["kind"]], "town"])
+	for e in cosmos.dungeons_of(pl):
+		var site: Dictionary = e[0]
+		places.append([(site["dir"] as Vector3) * (pl.radius + pl.shape.height(site["dir"])), "%s (%s)" % [site.get("name", "?"), site.get("kind", "cave")], "cave"])
+	for camp in cosmos.camps_of(pl):
+		places.append([camp[0], "Pirate camp", "foe"])
+	for lr in cosmos.lairs:
+		if is_instance_valid(lr) and lr.global_position.distance_to(me) < SCAN_FAR:
+			places.append([lr.global_position - pl.global_position, "Bio-signature", "foe"])
+	for c in cosmos.creatures:
+		if is_instance_valid(c) and c.get("hostile") and c.global_position.distance_to(me) < 400.0:
+			places.append([c.global_position - pl.global_position, str(c.get("label")) if c.get("label") else "Creature", "foe"])
+	var found := {"town": 0, "cave": 0, "foe": 0}
+	for p in places:
+		var at: Vector3 = pl.global_position + (p[0] as Vector3)
+		if at.distance_to(me) < SCAN_FAR:
+			scan_marks.append([p[0], pl, p[1], p[2], until])
+			found[p[2]] = int(found[p[2]]) + 1
+	cosmos.note_event("scanned")
+	cosmos.hud.flash("Scan: %d deposits near, %d towns, %d caves and dungeons, %d foes or camps" % [n_ore, found["town"], found["cave"], found["foe"]], 4.0)
+
+
+# --- Bounties ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func bounties() -> Dictionary:
+	return CosmosGame.extra.get("bounties", {})
+
+
+func add_bounty(dr: int) -> void:
+	var b := bounties()
+	b["n"] = int(b.get("n", 0)) + 1
+	b["dr"] = int(b.get("dr", 0)) + dr
+	CosmosGame.extra["bounties"] = b

files.explanation: New: the interactive tutorial - 17 steps in a small panel, done in any order and paid when done, kept in the save, ending early (with every reward) if your first ship came another way.

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,238 @@ 
+class_name CosmosTutor
+extends CanvasLayer
+## The interactive tutorial (a new game's, on foot on Amnissos): a short list of
+## things to learn by doing, shown one at a time in a small panel at the top
+## right - never in the way: nothing stops, nothing pops up, each step done in
+## whatever order you happen to do it (the panel shows the first not done yet),
+## each paid for as you do it - its drachmas toward your first ship. First on
+## foot (walking, the jet pack, the maps, the scanner, mining, selling ore,
+## couriering a package, a ride with a local pilot, your first ship), then your
+## ship (the controls, undocking, the Hyperion drive, docking, raiders, their
+## bounties). Got a ship another way? Once you've flown, docked and fought, it
+## ends and pays you everything it would have. F2 hides it (or shows it again).
+## Its state is in the save (CosmosGame.extra "tutor"); old saves have none - no tutorial.
+
+## [id, title, what to do, reward (dr), part]
+const STEPS := [
+	["walk", "Find your feet", "Walk about (W A S D, the mouse to look; Shift to run).", 40, 1],
+	["jet", "The jet pack", "Jump (Space), then hold Space in the air: the jet pack lifts you.", 40, 1],
+	["map", "The maps", "Open the Ship Computer (Tab): the MAP and GALAXY tabs - turn, pan and zoom them.", 40, 1],
+	["scan", "The scanner", "Press Z: ore deposits near you and the places round you are marked for a minute.", 50, 1],
+	["mine", "Mine a deposit", "Walk to a deposit and fire at it (left button): the mining beam cuts its ore. Get 5 units.", 80, 1],
+	["sell", "Sell your ore", "The city's ore buyer, by its landing field, pays for raw ore (E beside them).", 80, 1],
+	["package", "A courier's package", "The courier's office by the field gives you a package to carry to another world or a station.", 60, 1],
+	["drop", "Set it down, pick it up", "H sets the package down; H (or E) picks it up again.", 40, 1],
+	["ride", "A ride off-world", "The local pilot flies you there for a fee: their ship comes down on the field - walk up its ramp.", 60, 1],
+	["deliver", "Deliver it", "Hand the package over where it's going: the courier's office there, or a station's harbour officer.", 150, 1],
+	["ship", "Your first ship", "Couriering and ore pay; a station's shipyard (its services hall) sells ships - the cheapest about 13,800 dr.", 1500, 1],
+	["controls", "Take the controls", "Up your ship's ramp, forward to the cockpit, E at the pilot's seat.", 100, 2],
+	["undock", "Undock", "L (or Space) at the controls: up the lift and out.", 100, 2],
+	["cruise", "The Hyperion drive", "J: the drive takes you across the system in moments; J again drops out.", 100, 2],
+	["dock", "Dock", "Near a station, L asks for a pad: fly over it, line up with it, set down slowly.", 150, 2],
+	["fight", "Raiders", "Destroy two pirate raiders: aim with the mouse, fire with the left button.", 300, 2],
+	["bounty", "Bounties", "Hand your bounty vouchers in to a station's harbour officer.", 200, 2],
+]
+
+var cosmos: Cosmos
+var _panel: PanelContainer
+var _title: Label
+var _text: Label
+var _poll := 0.0
+var _start := Vector3.INF        # (where you were last frame)
+var _walked := 0.0
+var _jetted := false
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	layer = 4
+	_panel = PanelContainer.new()
+	_panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", NeonTheme.box(NeonTheme.HEAD))
+	_panel.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_TOP_RIGHT)
+	_panel.offset_left = -470
+	_panel.offset_right = -24
+	_panel.offset_top = 96
+	_panel.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
+	add_child(_panel)
+	var box := VBoxContainer.new()
+	box.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 4)
+	_panel.add_child(box)
+	_title = Label.new()
+	_title.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 19)
+	_title.add_theme_color_override("font_color", NeonTheme.CYAN)
+	box.add_child(_title)
+	_text = Label.new()
+	_text.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 16)
+	_text.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
+	_text.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(420, 0)
+	box.add_child(_text)
+	_show()
+
+
+static func state() -> Dictionary:
+	return CosmosGame.extra.get("tutor", {})
+
+
+static func active() -> bool:
+	var s := state()
+	return not s.is_empty() and not bool(s.get("finished", false))
+
+
+func _done() -> Dictionary:
+	var s := state()
+	if not s.has("done"):
+		s["done"] = {}
+	return s["done"]
+
+
+func is_done(id: String) -> bool:
+	return _done().has(id)
+
+
+## The first step not done yet: [index, step] (or [-1, []]).
+func current() -> Array:
+	for i in STEPS.size():
+		if not is_done(str(STEPS[i][0])):
+			return [i, STEPS[i]]
+	return [-1, []]
+
+
+## A step done (once): its reward paid, the panel on to the next.
+func complete(id: String) -> void:
+	if not active() or is_done(id):
+		return
+	for st in STEPS:
+		if st[0] == id:
+			_done()[id] = true
+			CosmosGame.data.add_credits(int(st[3]))
+			if cosmos and cosmos.hud:
+				cosmos.hud.flash("Tutorial: %s - done (+%d dr)" % [st[1], int(st[3])], 3.5)
+	_check_end()
+	_show()
+
+
+func on_event(e: String) -> void:
+	if not active():
+		return
+	var s := state()
+	match e:
+		"scanned": complete("scan")
+		"ore_sold": complete("sell")
+		"package_taken": complete("package")
+		"box_down":
+			s["box_down"] = true
+		"box_up":
+			if s.get("box_down", false):
+				complete("drop")
+		"ride_hired", "ride_boarded": complete("ride")
+		"package_delivered": complete("deliver")
+		"ship_bought":
+			_note_other_way()
+			complete("ship")
+		"at_controls": complete("controls")
+		"undocked": complete("undock")
+		"docked":
+			if is_done("undock"):
+				complete("dock")
+		"pirate_killed":
+			s["kills"] = int(s.get("kills", 0)) + 1
+			if int(s["kills"]) >= 2:
+				complete("fight")
+		"bounty_claimed": complete("bounty")
+		"map_opened": complete("map")
+
+
+## Polled twice a second: what's seen rather than told - walking, the jet pack,
+## ore in your pack, the drive, a ship got some other way.
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	if not active():
+		if _panel.visible:
+			_panel.visible = false
+		return
+	var w: Node3D = cosmos.walker if cosmos else null
+	if w:   # (every frame: the way walked - not a jump of the world's origin - and a moment's jet)
+		if _start != Vector3.INF:
+			var step := w.global_position.distance_to(_start)
+			if step < 5.0:
+				_walked += step
+		_start = w.global_position
+		if w.get("jetting"):
+			_jetted = true
+	_poll -= delta
+	if _poll > 0.0:
+		return
+	_poll = 0.5
+	if _walked > 20.0:
+		complete("walk")
+	if _jetted:
+		complete("jet")
+	var comp: Node = cosmos.get("_computer") if cosmos else null
+	if comp and is_instance_valid(comp) and comp.visible and int(comp.get("current")) in [1, 2]:
+		complete("map")   # (the Ship Computer open on its MAP or GALAXY tab)
+	var ore := 0
+	for id in Mining.MINERALS:
+		ore += CosmosGame.data.count(id)
+	if ore >= 5:
+		complete("mine")
+	if cosmos and cosmos.ship and cosmos.walker == null and cosmos.ship.cruise == 2:
+		complete("cruise")
+	if CosmosGame.has_ship() and not is_done("ship"):
+		_note_other_way()
+		complete("ship")   # (a ship got another way: the rest of the first part skipped - its rewards paid at the end)
+	_show()
+
+
+## It ends once you've done its last step - or have a ship and have flown, docked
+## and fought: every reward not yet paid then paid at once.
+func _check_end() -> void:
+	var s := state()
+	if bool(s.get("finished", false)):
+		return
+	var all: bool = int(current()[0]) == -1
+	var learned := bool(s.get("other_way", false)) and is_done("undock") and is_done("dock") and is_done("fight")
+	if not (all or learned):
+		return
+	var owed := 0
+	var paid: Dictionary = s.get("paid", {})
+	for st in STEPS:
+		if not is_done(str(st[0])):
+			owed += int(st[3])
+			_done()[st[0]] = true
+	s["finished"] = true
+	if owed > 0:
+		CosmosGame.data.add_credits(owed)
+	if cosmos and cosmos.hud:
+		cosmos.hud.flash("Tutorial complete%s - the sector's yours to explore" % ((" (+%d dr for the steps you went your own way on)" % owed) if owed > 0 else ""), 6.0)
+
+
+## Your first ship got before the first part's done (bought early, or another way):
+## then flying, docking and fighting are all it still asks before it ends.
+func _note_other_way() -> void:
+	for st in STEPS:
+		if int(st[4]) == 1 and st[0] != "ship" and not is_done(str(st[0])):
+			state()["other_way"] = true
+			return
+
+
+func toggle() -> void:
+	var s := state()
+	s["hidden"] = not bool(s.get("hidden", false))
+	_show()
+
+
+func _show() -> void:
+	if _panel == null:
+		return
+	var s := state()
+	var c := current()
+	_panel.visible = active() and not bool(s.get("hidden", false)) and int(c[0]) >= 0
+	if not _panel.visible:
+		return
+	var st: Array = c[1]
+	var part := "on foot" if int(st[4]) == 1 else "your ship"
