+class_name CosmosNpcInterior
+extends Node3D
+## A trader's insides, walkable - made when you come near one down in a port
+## (on a worker), fitted to its hull: the hull sliced across every metre, each
+## slice's room as wide and as high as the hull leaves there (a little in from
+## its skin; not out into the engine pods beside it), from the door at the top
+## of its stern ramp forward as far as there's room to stand. The cargo hold aft
+## (crates along its sides), the crew's quarters (bunks), the bridge at the
+## front (consoles, the pilot's seat). A doorway cut in the hull over the ramp
+## while it's down (EmpireKit.cut_mat). A deck for the walker as
+## CosmosShipInterior's and CosmosHangar's are: floor_y, ceiling_y, confine.
+## In the ship's own space (a child of it, unmoved).
+
+const SLICE := 1.0
+const DOOR_HW := 0.8          # the doorways between rooms (half width)
+const DOOR_H := 2.3
+const MAX_HW := 5.5
+const HEAD := 3.0             # its rooms' height at most
+
+var ship: Node3D
+var emp := ""
+var built := false
+var ok := false               # (rooms fitted - a hull too slight for any: no way in)
+var sill := 0.0               # the floor (the ramp's top)
+var z_aft := 0.0              # the door, at the ramp's hinge
+var z_fore := 0.0
+var z0 := 0.0                 # slice 0's aft... its fore edge (hws[i]: [z0 + i, z0 + i + 1])
+var hws: Array = []
+var ceils: Array = []
+var walls: Array = []         # the rooms' partitions (z)
+var rooms: Array = []         # [name, z fore, z aft]
+var blocks: Array = []        # furniture: [x0, z0, x1, z1]
+var seat_pos := Vector3.INF   # the passenger seat beside the pilot's (its sitting point), if there's room for one
+var seat := {"face": Vector3(0, 0, -1), "kind": "sit", "who": null}   # (the walker's seat: facing the nose)
+var ramp_hw := 1.2
+var foot := Vector3.ZERO      # the ramp's foot (ship space)
+var _cut_lo := Vector3.ZERO   # the doorway in the hull (its mesh's space)
+var _cut_hi := Vector3.ZERO
+var _hull: MeshInstance3D
+var _task := -1
+var _out := {}
+var _lights: Array = []
+var _light_t := 0.0
+
+
+func setup(s: Node3D, e: String) -> void:
+	ship = s
+	emp = e
+	name = "Interior"
+	for mi: MeshInstance3D in s.find_children("*", "MeshInstance3D", true, false):
+		if mi.mesh and mi.mesh.has_meta("verts"):
+			_hull = mi
+			break
+	var ramp: Node3D = s.get("_ramp")
+	if _hull == null or ramp == null:
+		built = true
+		return
+	var hb: AABB = s.call("_hull_box")
+	var plank: Node3D = ramp.get_child(0)
+	ramp_hw = plank.scale.x * 0.5
+	var ang: float = s.get("_ramp_ang")
+	foot = ramp.position + Vector3(0, -sin(ang), cos(ang)) * float(s.get("_ramp_len"))
+	sill = ramp.position.y + plank.scale.y * 0.5   # (the ramp's top face at its hinge)
+	z_aft = ramp.position.z
+	var xf := _to_ship(_hull)
+	var args := [_hull.mesh.get_meta("verts"), xf, hb, sill, z_aft, ramp_hw]
+	_task = WorkerThreadPool.add_task(func(): _out = _make(args), false, "trader interior")
+
+
+func _to_ship(n: Node3D) -> Transform3D:
+	var xf := Transform3D()
+	var at: Node = n
+	while at != ship and at != null:
+		xf = (at as Node3D).transform * xf
+		at = at.get_parent()
+	return xf
+
+
+func _exit_tree() -> void:
+	if _task >= 0:
+		WorkerThreadPool.wait_for_task_completion(_task)
+		_task = -1
+
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	if _task >= 0:
+		if not WorkerThreadPool.is_task_completed(_task):
+			return
+		WorkerThreadPool.wait_for_task_completion(_task)
+		_task = -1
+		_finish()
+	_light_t -= delta
+	if _light_t <= 0.0 and not _lights.is_empty():   # (its lamps lit only with you aboard - from outside, their strips glow through the door)
+		_light_t = 0.25
+		var c: Node = ship.get("cosmos") if ship else null
+		var w: Node = c.get("walker") if c else null
+		var aboard: bool = w != null and w.get("deck") == self
+		for o: OmniLight3D in _lights:
+			o.visible = aboard
+
+
+func _finish() -> void:
+	built = true
+	if _out.is_empty():
+		return
+	ok = true
+	for k in ["z_fore", "z0", "hws", "ceils", "walls", "rooms", "blocks"]:
+		set(k, _out[k])
+	seat_pos = _out.get("seat", Vector3.INF)
+	var tunnel: float = _out["tunnel"]
+	var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
+	mi.name = "Rooms"
+	mi.mesh = _out["mesh"]
+	mi.material_override = EmpireKit.mat("inside", emp)
+	mi.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
+	add_child(mi)
+	for r in rooms:
+		var o := OmniLight3D.new()
+		var zm := (float(r[1]) + float(r[2])) * 0.5
+		o.position = Vector3(0, _ceil_at(zm) - 0.35, zm)
+		o.omni_range = maxf(float(r[2]) - float(r[1]), 6.0)
+		o.omni_attenuation = 0.9
+		o.light_energy = 1.3
+		o.light_color = Color(1.0, 0.86, 0.68) if r[0] != "Bridge" else Color(0.85, 0.92, 1.0)
+		o.shadow_enabled = false
+		o.visible = false
+		add_child(o)
+		_lights.append(o)
+	# The doorway through the hull: over the ramp's top, from the rooms' aft end out past the stern.
+	var inv := _to_ship(_hull).affine_inverse()
+	var a := inv * Vector3(-ramp_hw - 0.05, sill - 0.4, tunnel - 0.4)
+	var b := inv * Vector3(ramp_hw + 0.05, sill + DOOR_H + 0.25, z_aft + 40.0)
+	_cut_lo = Vector3(minf(a.x, b.x), minf(a.y, b.y), minf(a.z, b.z))
+	_cut_hi = Vector3(maxf(a.x, b.x), maxf(a.y, b.y), maxf(a.z, b.z))
+	add_to_group("cam_solid")   # (its walls between rooms stop the camera - aboard: cam_hit)
+	set_meta("cam_reach", 120.0)
+	if _hull.material_override is ShaderMaterial:
+		_hull.material_override = EmpireKit.cut_mat(_hull.material_override)
+	set_cut(true)
+
+
+## The doorway open in the hull (the ramp down) or not (it's shut: the hull whole).
+func set_cut(open: bool) -> void:
+	if _hull == null or not ok:
+		return
+	_hull.set_instance_shader_parameter("cut_lo", _cut_lo if open else Vector3.ZERO)
+	_hull.set_instance_shader_parameter("cut_hi", _cut_hi if open else Vector3.ZERO)
+
+
+# --- The walker's deck --------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func _slice(z: float) -> int:
+	return clampi(int(floor((z - z0) / SLICE)), 0, hws.size() - 1)
+
+
+func _hw_at(z: float, m := 0.0) -> float:
+	return minf(float(hws[_slice(z - m)]), float(hws[_slice(z + m)]))
+
+
+func _ceil_at(z: float) -> float:
+	return float(ceils[_slice(z)])
+
+
+func on_ramp(l: Vector3) -> bool:
+	return l.z > z_aft and ramp_open()
+
+
+## Its ramp down (in port): the door at its top open.
+func ramp_open() -> bool:
+	return ship != null and float(ship.get("_ramp_k")) > 0.5
+
+
+func floor_y(l: Vector3) -> float:
+	if on_ramp(l):
+		return lerpf(sill, foot.y, clampf((l.z - z_aft) / maxf(foot.z - z_aft, 0.1), 0.0, 1.0))
+	return sill
+
+
+func ceiling_y(l: Vector3) -> float:
+	if on_ramp(l) or not ok:
+		return floor_y(l) + 3.2
+	return _ceil_at(l.z)
+
+
+## `l` kept within its rooms (and on the ramp), `m` in from their walls and things.
+func confine(l: Vector3, m: float) -> Vector3:
+	if not ok:
+		return l
+	var p := l
+	if not ramp_open():
+		p.z = minf(p.z, z_aft - m)   # (its ramp up: the door shut behind you)
+	elif p.z > z_aft:   # (the ramp: down to its foot - off it, Cosmos puts you on the port's floor)
+		p.x = clampf(p.x, -ramp_hw + m, ramp_hw - m)
+		p.z = minf(p.z, foot.z + 0.6)
+		return p
+	p.z = maxf(p.z, z_fore + m)
+	if p.z > z_aft - m and absf(p.x) > ramp_hw - m:   # (the aft wall, either side of the door)
+		p.z = z_aft - m
+	for wz: float in walls:   # (the partitions: through their doorways only)
+		if absf(p.z - wz) < m + 0.1 and absf(p.x) > DOOR_HW - m:
+			p.z = wz + (m + 0.1) * (1.0 if p.z > wz else -1.0)
+	var hw := _hw_at(p.z, m)   # (its width where it ends up along the ship)
+	p.x = clampf(p.x, -hw + m, hw - m)
+	for b in blocks:
+		var x0: float = b[0] - m
+		var zz0: float = b[1] - m
+		var x1: float = b[2] + m
+		var zz1: float = b[3] + m
+		if p.x > x0 and p.x < x1 and p.z > zz0 and p.z < zz1:
+			var opts := [[p.x - x0, Vector3(x0, p.y, p.z)], [x1 - p.x, Vector3(x1, p.y, p.z)],
+				[p.z - zz0, Vector3(p.x, p.y, zz0)], [zz1 - p.z, Vector3(p.x, p.y, zz1)]]
+			opts.sort_custom(func(a, c): return a[0] < c[0])
+			p = opts[0][1]
+	p.x = clampf(p.x, -hw + m, hw - m)   # (never out through a wall, pushed off a thing)
+	return p
+
+
+## The camera's ray (`o`, `dir`, world) stopped short of the walls across its
+## rooms - outside their doorways - while you're aboard (else nothing here).
+func cam_hit(o: Vector3, dir: Vector3, limit: float) -> float:
+	var c: Node = ship.get("cosmos") if ship else null
+	var w: Node = c.get("walker") if c else null
+	if w == null or w.get("deck") != self or (c.get("cam") and c.cam.walker == null):
+		return INF   # (not aboard - or in the passenger seat, looking at it from outside)
+	var lo := to_local(o)
+	var ld := global_basis.inverse() * dir
+	if absf(ld.z) < 1e-5:
+		return INF
+	var best := INF
+	var across: Array = walls.duplicate()
+	across.append(z_aft)
+	for wz: float in across:
+		var t := (wz - lo.z) / ld.z
+		if t <= 0.0 or t > limit:
+			continue
+		var p := lo + ld * t
+		var dhw := ramp_hw if is_equal_approx(wz, z_aft) else DOOR_HW
+		if absf(p.x) > dhw - 0.15 or p.y > sill + DOOR_H - 0.15:
+			best = minf(best, t)
+	return maxf(best - 0.25, 0.2) if best < INF else INF
+
+
+## Where you are aboard: its room's name.
+func room_at(l: Vector3) -> String:
+	if on_ramp(l):
+		return "the ramp"
+	for r in rooms:
+		if l.z >= float(r[1]) and l.z <= float(r[2]):
+			return str(r[0]).to_lower()
+	return "the corridor"
+
+
+# --- Made on a worker: the layout and the mesh ------------------------------------------
+
+static func _make(args: Array) -> Dictionary:
+	var src: PackedVector3Array = args[0]
+	var xf: Transform3D = args[1]
+	var hb: AABB = args[2]
+	var sill: float = args[3]
+	var z_aft: float = args[4]
+	var rhw: float = args[5]
+	var zs := hb.position.z
+	var n := int(ceil((z_aft - zs) / SLICE))
+	if n < 5:
+		return {}
+	# Each slice's cross-section through its middle: the hull's triangles cut by
+	# that plane, the cut lines sampled every 0.4 m - as (|x|, y) points.
+	var sec: Array = []
+	for i in n:
+		sec.append(PackedVector2Array())
+	var k := 0
+	while k + 2 < src.size():
+		var a: Vector3 = xf * src[k]
+		var b: Vector3 = xf * src[k + 1]
+		var c: Vector3 = xf * src[k + 2]
+		k += 3
+		var lo := minf(a.z, minf(b.z, c.z))
+		var hi := maxf(a.z, maxf(b.z, c.z))
+		var i0 := maxi(int(ceil((lo - zs) / SLICE - 0.5)), 0)
+		var i1 := mini(int(floor((hi - zs) / SLICE - 0.5)), n - 1)
+		for i in range(i0, i1 + 1):
+			var zm := zs + (i + 0.5) * SLICE
+			var cut: Array = []
+			for e in [[a, b], [b, c], [c, a]]:
+				var p: Vector3 = e[0]
+				var q: Vector3 = e[1]
+				if (p.z - zm) * (q.z - zm) <= 0.0 and absf(q.z - p.z) > 1e-6:
+					cut.append(p.lerp(q, (zm - p.z) / (q.z - p.z)))
+			if cut.size() >= 2:
+				var p0: Vector3 = cut[0]
+				var p1: Vector3 = cut[1]
+				var steps := maxi(1, int(p0.distance_to(p1) / 0.4))
+				for st in steps + 1:
+					var p := p0.lerp(p1, float(st) / steps)
+					sec[i].append(Vector2(absf(p.x), p.y))
+	# The rooms' width (to the nearest skin at standing height, a little in from it) and
+	# height (to the lowest skin over them) per slice - standing room where there's enough,
+	# and the hull closed under its floor.
+	var hw: Array = []
+	var ce: Array = []
+	var good: Array = []
+	for i in n:
+		var pts: PackedVector2Array = sec[i]
+		var near := INF
+		for p in pts:
+			if p.y > sill + 0.1 and p.y < sill + 2.2:
+				near = minf(near, p.x)
+		var w := snappedf(minf(near - 0.4, MAX_HW), 0.1) if near < INF else 0.0
+		var over := INF
+		var belly := false
+		for p in pts:
+			if p.x <= w + 0.2:
+				if p.y > sill + 0.5:
+					over = minf(over, p.y)
+				elif p.y < sill - 0.05:
+					belly = true
+		var c := minf(sill + HEAD, over - 0.3)
+		hw.append(w)
+		ce.append(c)
+		good.append(w >= 0.85 and c - sill >= 2.2 and belly)
+	# The rooms: the longest stretch with standing room that reaches near the stern;
+	# from its aft end to the door a corridor (through whatever's there: the doorway
+	# cut in the hull runs its length).
+	var max_skip := maxi(7, int(n * 0.4))
+	var best := [-1, -1]
+	var j := 0
+	while j < n:
+		if not good[j]:
+			j += 1
+			continue
+		var e := j
+		while e + 1 < n and good[e + 1]:
+			e += 1
+		if e >= n - 1 - max_skip and e - j + 1 >= 5 and (best[0] < 0 or e - j > int(best[1]) - int(best[0])):
+			best = [j, e]
+		j = e + 1
+	if best[0] < 0:
+		return {}
+	var i_fore: int = best[0]
+	var i_aft: int = best[1]
+	for i in range(i_aft + 1, n):   # (the passage: as wide as the ramp, door high)
+		hw[i] = maxf(rhw + 0.15, 0.85)
+		ce[i] = sill + DOOR_H + 0.15
+	var z_fore := zs + i_fore * SLICE
+	var tunnel := minf(zs + (i_aft + 1) * SLICE, z_aft)
+	var hws := hw.slice(i_fore)
+	var ceils := ce.slice(i_fore)
+	# The rooms: the hold aft, the quarters, the bridge at the front.
+	var L := tunnel - z_fore
+	var rooms: Array = []
+	if L < 7.0:
+		rooms = [["Cabin", z_fore, tunnel]]
+	elif L < 14.0:
+		rooms = [["Bridge", z_fore, z_fore + L * 0.45], ["Cargo hold", z_fore + L * 0.45, tunnel]]
+	else:
+		rooms = [["Bridge", z_fore, z_fore + L * 0.28], ["Crew quarters", z_fore + L * 0.28, z_fore + L * 0.6], ["Cargo hold", z_fore + L * 0.6, tunnel]]
+	var walls: Array = []
+	for r in rooms.slice(1):
+		walls.append(snappedf(float(r[1]), 0.01))
+	if tunnel < z_aft - 0.5:   # (a passage through the tail: a door at its fore end too)
+		walls.append(tunnel)
+	var lay := {"z_fore": z_fore, "z0": z_fore, "hws": hws, "ceils": ceils, "walls": walls, "rooms": rooms, "blocks": [], "tunnel": tunnel}
+	lay["mesh"] = _mesh(lay, sill, z_aft, rhw)
+	return lay
+
+
+## Unknown entries (`gap`) from their nearest known neighbour.
+static func _fill(a: Array, gap := -1.0) -> void:
+	for i in a.size():
+		if a[i] != gap:
+			continue
+		for d in range(1, a.size()):
+			if i - d >= 0 and a[i - d] != gap:
+				a[i] = a[i - d]
+				break
+			if i + d < a.size() and a[i + d] != gap:
+				a[i] = a[i + d]
+				break
+
+
+static func _mesh(lay: Dictionary, sill: float, z_aft: float, rhw: float) -> ArrayMesh:
+	var m := EmpireKit.Mesher.new()
+	var hws: Array = lay["hws"]
+	var ceils: Array = lay["ceils"]
+	var z0: float = lay["z0"]
+	var blocks: Array = lay["blocks"]
+	var wall := EmpireKit.MAIN
+	var n := hws.size()
+	for i in n:
+		var za := z0 + i * SLICE
+		var zb := minf(za + SLICE, z_aft)
+		if zb <= za:
+			break
+		var w: float = hws[i]
+		var c: float = ceils[i]
+		var mid := (za + zb) * 0.5
+		var len := zb - za
+		m.boxat(Vector3(w * 2.0 + 0.24, 0.12, len), Vector3(0, sill - 0.06, mid), EmpireKit.STEEL)
+		m.boxat(Vector3(w * 2.0 + 0.24, 0.12, len), Vector3(0, c + 0.06, mid), EmpireKit.IRON)
+		for sx in [-1.0, 1.0]:
+			m.boxat(Vector3(0.12, c - sill, len), Vector3(sx * (w + 0.06), (sill + c) * 0.5, mid), wall)
+			m.boxat(Vector3(0.05, 0.08, len), Vector3(sx * (w - 0.02), sill + 0.9, mid), EmpireKit.ACCENT)   # (a rail along its walls)
+		if i % 2 == 0:
+			m.boxat(Vector3(0.24, 0.04, len * 0.8), Vector3(0, c - 0.02, mid), EmpireKit.LAMP)
+		if i + 1 < n:   # (steps in the walls and the ceiling where the hull narrows)
+			var w2: float = hws[i + 1]
+			var c2: float = ceils[i + 1]
+			if absf(w2 - w) > 0.01:
+				var lo := minf(w, w2)
+				var hi := maxf(w, w2)
+				for sx in [-1.0, 1.0]:
+					m.boxat(Vector3(hi - lo + 0.12, maxf(c, c2) - sill, 0.12), Vector3(sx * (lo + hi) * 0.5, (sill + maxf(c, c2)) * 0.5, zb), wall)
+			if absf(c2 - c) > 0.01:
+				m.boxat(Vector3(minf(w, w2) * 2.0, absf(c2 - c) + 0.12, 0.12), Vector3(0, (c + c2) * 0.5, zb), EmpireKit.IRON)
+	# The fore wall; the aft one round the door; the partitions with their doorways.
+	var zf: float = lay["z_fore"]
+	m.boxat(Vector3(float(hws[0]) * 2.0 + 0.24, float(ceils[0]) - sill, 0.12), Vector3(0, (sill + float(ceils[0])) * 0.5, zf - 0.06), wall)

+## field, origin on its deck) of `pl`, its ramp down for you; then (aboard) to `to`:
+## {"pl": planet, "field": transform} (another world's town) or {"station": node}.
+func hire_ride(pl: CosmosPlanet, field: Transform3D, to: Dictionary) -> void:
+	_make_gear()
+	hire = {"state": "arrive", "t": 0.0, "pl": pl, "field": field, "to": to}
+	var u := field.basis.y
+	global_transform = Transform3D(field.basis, pl.global_position + field.origin + u * HIRE_ALT + field.basis.z * 600.0)
+
+
+func hire_state() -> String:
+	return str(hire.get("state", ""))
+
+
+## Down on a field with its ramp down (to walk on or off).
+func hire_open() -> bool:
+	return hire_state() in ["wait", "landed"] and _ramp_k > 0.99
+
+
+func _rest_xf(pl: CosmosPlanet, field: Transform3D) -> Transform3D:
+	return Transform3D(field.basis, pl.global_position + field.origin + field.basis.y * rest_height())
+
+
+func _hire_fly(delta: float) -> void:
+	hire["t"] = float(hire["t"]) + delta
+	var t: float = hire["t"]
+	var st := hire_state()
+	var aboard: bool = cosmos != null and cosmos.riding() == self
+	var pl: CosmosPlanet = hire["pl"]
+	var field: Transform3D = hire["field"]
+	if not is_instance_valid(pl):
+		hire = {}
+		queue_free()
+		return
+	var to: Dictionary = hire["to"]
+	match st:
+		"arrive", "descend":   # (down onto the field, legs out near the ground)
+			var k := smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, minf(t / 12.0, 1.0))
+			var rest := _rest_xf(pl, field)
+			var from := rest.origin + field.basis.y * HIRE_ALT + field.basis.z * 600.0
+			global_transform = Transform3D(field.basis, from.lerp(rest.origin, k))
+			_gear_step(1.0 if k > 0.7 else 0.0, 0.0, delta)
+			_engines_glow(0.6)
+			if k >= 1.0:
+				hire["state"] = "wait" if st == "arrive" else "landed"
+				hire["t"] = 0.0
+		"wait":   # (on the field, its ramp down: waiting for you)
+			global_transform = _rest_xf(pl, field)
+			_gear_step(1.0, 1.0, delta)
+			_engines_glow(0.0)
+			if aboard and interior and interior.ok and interior.to_local(cosmos.walker.global_position).z < interior.z_aft - 1.5:
+				hire["aboard_t"] = float(hire.get("aboard_t", 0.0)) + delta
+				if float(hire["aboard_t"]) > 2.5:   # (you're in, clear of the ramp: off)
+					hire["state"] = "climb"
+					hire["t"] = 0.0
+			elif t > HIRE_WAIT and not aboard:
+				hire["state"] = "leave"
+				hire["t"] = 0.0
+		"climb":   # (the ramp up, straight up off the field)
+			_gear_step(0.0, 0.0, delta)
+			var k := smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, clampf((t - 2.5) / 9.0, 0.0, 1.0))
+			var rest := _rest_xf(pl, field)
+			global_transform = Transform3D(field.basis, rest.origin + field.basis.y * HIRE_ALT * k)
+			_engines_glow(0.6)
+			if k >= 1.0:
+				hire["state"] = "out"
+				hire["t"] = 0.0
+		"out", "in":   # (round the planet, over its ground, to face the way it's going / from it)
+			var here: CosmosPlanet = pl if st == "out" else to["pl"]
+			var fu: Vector3 = (field if st == "out" else to["field"] as Transform3D).basis.y
+			var aim := _hire_aim()
+			var dir := (aim - here.global_position).normalized() if st == "out" else (_hire_from() - here.global_position).normalized()
+			var k := smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, minf(t / 9.0, 1.0))
+			var a: Vector3 = fu.slerp(dir, k) if st == "out" else dir.slerp(fu, k)
+			var r: float = here.radius + lerpf(HIRE_ALT, HIRE_ARC, 1.0 - absf(k * 2.0 - 1.0)) if st == "out" else here.radius + lerpf(HIRE_ARC, HIRE_ALT, k)
+			var p := here.global_position + a.normalized() * r
+			_face(p - global_position, a)
+			global_position = p
+			_engines_glow(0.6)
+			if k >= 1.0:
+				hire["state"] = "transfer" if st == "out" else "descend"
+				hire["t"] = 0.0
+				if st == "out":
+					hire["from"] = global_position - pl.global_position
+					hire["dur"] = clampf(global_position.distance_to(_hire_aim()) / 12000.0, 6.0, 40.0)
+				else:
+					hire["pl"] = to["pl"]
+					hire["field"] = to["field"]
+		"transfer":   # (across the system on its drive: a smooth run from its world to the other)
+			var dur: float = hire["dur"]
+			var k := smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, minf(t / dur, 1.0))
+			var a: Vector3 = pl.global_position + (hire["from"] as Vector3)
+			var p := a.lerp(_hire_aim(), k)
+			_face(p - global_position, global_basis.y)
+			global_position = p
+			_engines_glow(0.8)
+			if k >= 1.0:
+				if to.has("station"):   # (a station: its pads and its port, as any trader's)
+					hire = {}
+					dest = to["station"]
+					set_meta("hired", true)
+				else:
+					hire["state"] = "in"
+					hire["t"] = 0.0
+		"landed":   # (there: its ramp down until you've walked off, then away)
+			global_transform = _rest_xf(pl, field)
+			_gear_step(1.0, 1.0, delta)
+			_engines_glow(0.0)
+			if aboard:
+				hire["t"] = 0.0
+			elif t > 12.0:
+				hire["state"] = "leave"
+				hire["t"] = 0.0
+		"leave":   # (up and gone)
+			_gear_step(0.0, 0.0, delta)
+			var rest := _rest_xf(pl, field)
+			var k := clampf((t - 2.5) / 10.0, 0.0, 1.0)
+			global_transform = Transform3D(field.basis, rest.origin + field.basis.y * HIRE_ALT * 2.5 * k * k)
+			_engines_glow(0.6)
+			if k >= 1.0 and not aboard:
+				if cosmos:
+					cosmos.npc_ships.erase(self)
+				queue_free()
+
+
+## Where its run across the system ends: over the far side of the other world (or off the station).
+func _hire_aim() -> Vector3:
+	var to: Dictionary = hire["to"]
+	var from := _hire_from()
+	if to.has("station"):
+		var st: Node3D = to["station"]
+		var r: float = cosmos.radius_of(st) + 2500.0 if cosmos else 3000.0
+		return st.global_position + (from - st.global_position).normalized() * r
+	var dp: CosmosPlanet = to["pl"]
+	return dp.global_position + (from - dp.global_position).normalized() * (dp.radius + HIRE_ARC)
+
+
+func _hire_from() -> Vector3:
+	var pl: CosmosPlanet = hire["pl"]
+	return pl.global_position if is_instance_valid(pl) else global_position
+
+
+func _face(go: Vector3, up_: Vector3) -> void:
+	if go.length() < 0.01:
+		return
+	var f := go.normalized()
+	var u := (up_ - f * up_.dot(f)).normalized()
+	if u.length() < 0.5:
+		u = global_basis.y
+	global_basis = global_basis.slerp(Basis.looking_at(f, u), 0.15).orthonormalized()

+var _nav: AStarGrid2D

+
+func _make_nav(holes: Array) -> AStarGrid2D:
+	var g := AStarGrid2D.new()
+	_nav_o = Vector2i(floori(xi) - 1, floori(-W) - 1)

+	g.default_compute_heuristic = AStarGrid2D.HEURISTIC_OCTILE
+	g.default_estimate_heuristic = AStarGrid2D.HEURISTIC_OCTILE

+				var c := Vector2i(x, z) - _nav_o

+	var staff: Array = h.people.filter(func(q): return not q.get("leaving", false) and q["role"] in ["bartender", "officer", "guard", "dock", "carrier"])   # (at work - off duty, they're in the bar or the lounge)

+	var crew: Array = People.crew_of(str(r["id"]))
+	var ashore: Array = []

+## Every empire's traders can be walked into: rooms fitted inside the hull from the

+func test_trader_interiors_fit_their_hulls() -> void:

+				await tree.process_frame
+			var tag := "%s %s" % [emp, s.hull_kind]

+					low = minf(low, float(inn.ceils[i]) - inn.sill)
+				check(low >= 2.1, "%s: standing room everywhere (%.1f m at the lowest)" % [tag, low])
+				s._ramp_k = 1.0   # (its ramp down, as in port)
+				check(absf(inn.foot.y + s.rest_height()) < 0.05, "%s: the ramp's foot on the pad's deck" % tag)
+				var far := inn.confine(Vector3(40.0, inn.sill, (inn.z_fore + inn.z_aft) * 0.5), 0.45)
+				check(absf(far.x) < float(inn.hws[inn._slice(far.z)]), "%s: the walls keep you in" % tag)
+				s._ramp_k = 0.0
+				check(inn.confine(Vector3(0, inn.sill, inn.foot.z), 0.45).z < inn.z_aft, "%s: its ramp up, the door shut behind you" % tag)
+				s._ramp_k = 1.0
+				check(is_equal_approx(inn.floor_y(Vector3(0, 0, inn.foot.z)), inn.foot.y) and is_equal_approx(inn.floor_y(Vector3(0, 0, inn.z_aft - 1.0)), inn.sill), "%s: the ramp from the deck up to its floor" % tag)

+## Your ship left where you left it (riding a trader on through a gate): in another
+## system it isn't here at all; a save in a port keeps where it is and where you are;
+## recalled, it comes - from the other system, a while - down this port's lift.
+func test_ship_left_behind_and_recalled() -> void:

@@ -1,0 +1,197 @@ 
+extends TestCase
+## The galaxy (120 systems through a 3D volume, its lanes, the bake), the
+## galaxy map's fog of war and course planner, and the Ship Computer's 3D
+## maps (the solar map, the galaxy map).
+
+
+func setup() -> void:
+	Galaxy.new_game(false, true)
+
+
+func test_galaxy_has_120_systems_in_six_empires() -> void:
+	check_eq(Galaxy.SYSTEMS.size(), 120, "systems")
+	var count := {}
+	for id in Galaxy.SYSTEMS:
+		var o: String = Galaxy.SYSTEMS[id]["owner"]
+		count[o] = int(count.get(o, 0)) + 1
+	for e in Galaxy.EMPIRE_SIZE:
+		check_eq(int(count.get(e, 0)), Galaxy.EMPIRE_SIZE[e], e + " systems")
+	check_eq(int(count.get("pirates", 0)), Galaxy.PIRATE_DENS, "Sea Peoples' dens")
+	# The hand-made heart kept as it was (the story's systems, ids saves use).
+	check_eq(Galaxy.SYSTEMS["atrapos"]["name"], "Knossos", "Knossos is home")
+	check_eq(Galaxy.SYSTEMS["atrapos"]["owner"], "minoa", "Knossos is Minoan")
+	for id in Galaxy.BASE_SYSTEMS:
+		check(Galaxy.SYSTEMS.has(id), "kept: " + id)
+		check((Galaxy.SYSTEMS[id]["pos"] as Vector2).is_equal_approx(Galaxy.BASE_SYSTEMS[id]["pos"]), "same place on the old map: " + id)
+	for id in ["g1_sitia", "g20_naxia", "g41_elis"]:
+		check(Galaxy.SYSTEMS.has(id), "the first round's systems kept: " + id)
+
+
+func test_names_never_repeat() -> void:
+	var names := {}
+	for id in Galaxy.SYSTEMS:
+		var n: String = Galaxy.SYSTEMS[id]["name"]
+		check(not names.has(n), "one system called " + n)
+		names[n] = true
+		check(not n.right(1).is_valid_int(), "a real place's name, not a number: " + n)
+	for pool in [Galaxy.PLANET_NAMES, Galaxy.STATION_ROOTS]:
+		for e in pool:
+			for n in pool[e]:
+				check(not names.has(n), "no system named like a planet or station: " + n)
+
+
+func test_spread_through_3d() -> void:
+	var lo := Vector3(INF, INF, INF)
+	var hi := -lo
+	var above := 0
+	var below := 0
+	for id in Galaxy.SYSTEMS:
+		var p: Vector3 = Galaxy.SYSTEMS[id]["pos3"]
+		check((Galaxy.SYSTEMS[id]["pos"] as Vector2).is_equal_approx(Vector2(p.x, p.z)), "pos is pos3 from above: " + id)
+		lo = lo.min(p)
+		hi = hi.max(p)
+		if p.y > 150.0:
+			above += 1
+		elif p.y < -150.0:
+			below += 1
+	var span := hi - lo
+	check(span.y > 900.0, "real height spread (%.0f)" % span.y)
+	check(span.x > 1800.0 and span.z > 1500.0, "wide (%.0f x %.0f)" % [span.x, span.z])
+	check(above >= 20 and below >= 20, "systems well above and below the middle plane (%d, %d)" % [above, below])
+	# Apart from each other.
+	var ids: Array = Galaxy.SYSTEMS.keys()
+	var closest := INF
+	for i in ids.size():
+		for j in range(i + 1, ids.size()):
+			closest = minf(closest, (Galaxy.SYSTEMS[ids[i]]["pos3"] as Vector3).distance_to(Galaxy.SYSTEMS[ids[j]]["pos3"]))
+	check(closest > 60.0, "no two systems on top of each other (%.0f)" % closest)
+
+
+func test_lanes_connect_everything() -> void:
+	var seen := {Galaxy.HOME: 0}
+	var queue := [Galaxy.HOME]
+	while not queue.is_empty():
+		var c: String = queue.pop_front()
+		for n in Galaxy.neighbors(c):
+			if not seen.has(n):
+				seen[n] = int(seen[c]) + 1
+				queue.append(n)
+	check_eq(seen.size(), 120, "every system reachable from Knossos")
+	check(seen.values().max() <= 16, "no system too many jumps away (%d)" % seen.values().max())
+	var longest := 0.0
+	for l in Galaxy.LINKS:
+		longest = maxf(longest, (Galaxy.SYSTEMS[l[0]]["pos3"] as Vector3).distance_to(Galaxy.SYSTEMS[l[1]]["pos3"]))
+		check(l[0] != l[1], "a lane joins two systems")
+	check(longest < 420.0, "lanes join near systems (longest %.0f)" % longest)
+	# Gates in every system, none on top of another.
+	for id in Galaxy.SYSTEMS:
+		var gates: Dictionary = Galaxy.system(id)["gates"]
+		check_eq(gates.size(), Galaxy.neighbors(id).size(), "a gate for every lane: " + id)
+		var dirs: Array = gates.values()
+		for i in dirs.size():
+			check((dirs[i] as Vector2).length() > 1000.0, "a gate on the system's edge: " + id)
+			for j in range(i + 1, dirs.size()):
+				check((dirs[i] as Vector2).distance_to(dirs[j]) > 800.0, "gates apart in " + id)
+
+
+func test_bake_is_current_and_fast() -> void:
+	var fresh: Array = Galaxy.grow_fresh()
+	check_eq(fresh[0].keys(), Galaxy.SYSTEMS.keys(), "the bake (data/galaxy.json) is the galaxy grown now - stale: godot --headless --path . -s tools/bake_galaxy.gd")
+	check_eq(str(fresh[1]), str(Galaxy.LINKS), "the same lanes")
+	var t := Time.get_ticks_usec()
+	var g: GDScript = load("res://scripts/sim/galaxy.gd")
+	var read: Array = g._read_layout()
+	check(not read.is_empty(), "the bake reads back (its key matches)")
+	check_lt((Time.get_ticks_usec() - t) / 1000.0, 30.0, "reading the bake (ms)")
+
+
+func test_fog_of_war_and_routes() -> void:
+	check(Galaxy.has_been(Galaxy.HOME), "Knossos counts as visited")
+	check_eq(Galaxy.been.size(), 1, "only Knossos at the start")
+	var n: String = Galaxy.neighbors(Galaxy.HOME)[0]
+	check(Galaxy.is_known(n), "a neighbour known (its gate names it)")
+	var far := ""
+	for id in Galaxy.SYSTEMS:
+		if not Galaxy.is_known(id):
+			far = id
+			break
+	check(far != "", "systems beyond: unknown")
+	check(Galaxy.find_known_route(Galaxy.HOME, far).is_empty(), "no route through systems you haven't been in")
+	check_eq(Galaxy.find_known_route(Galaxy.HOME, n).size(), 2, "a route to the uncharted system next door")
+	# Arriving: been there, the route moves on.
+	var path := Galaxy.find_route(Galaxy.HOME, far)
+	Galaxy.route = path
+	Galaxy.current_system = path[1]
+	check(Galaxy.has_been(path[1]), "arriving marks it visited")
+	check_eq(Galaxy.route[0], path[1], "the route moves on from here")
+	Galaxy.current_system = path[-1]
+	check(Galaxy.route.is_empty(), "the route done at its end")
+	# Saved and loaded.
+	var d: Dictionary = Galaxy.get_save_data()
+	Galaxy.load_save_data(JSON.parse_string(JSON.stringify(d)))
+	check(Galaxy.has_been(path[1]) and Galaxy.has_been(path[-1]), "visited systems saved")
+	# An old save (no "been"): the systems with a fog of their own count.
+	d.erase("been")
+	d["explored"] = {path[1]: ""}
+	Galaxy.load_save_data(d)
+	check(Galaxy.has_been(path[1]) and Galaxy.has_been(Galaxy.current_system), "an old save's visited systems")
+
+
+func test_galaxy_map_page() -> void:
+	var page: Control = load("res://scripts/ui/pages/galaxy_page.gd").new()
+	page.size = Vector2(1500, 800)
+	tree.root.add_child(page)
+	await tree.process_frame
+	page.refresh()
+	for i in 3:
+		await tree.process_frame
+	var v: Node = page._view
+	check(v.marks.has(Galaxy.HOME), "home on the map")
+	for id in v.marks:
+		check(Galaxy.is_known(id), "only what you know shows: " + id)
+	check_eq(v.shown.size(), Galaxy.been.size(), "the systems shown: the ones visited")
+	var n: String = Galaxy.neighbors(Galaxy.HOME)[0]
+	check(v.stubs.has(n), "a stub to the uncharted neighbour")
+	page.select(n)

+extends TestCase
+## The interactive tutorial (CosmosTutor) and the sandbox start: its steps done in
+## any order and paid for, shown one at a time; docking counts only after undocking;
+## following it to the end; ending early - all its rewards paid - when your first
+## ship came another way and you've flown, docked and fought; old saves without one.
+
+var _extra := {}
+
+
+func setup() -> void:
+	CosmosGame.ensure()
+	_extra = CosmosGame.extra.duplicate(true)
+
+
+func teardown() -> void:
+	CosmosGame.extra = _extra
+
+
+func _fresh() -> CosmosTutor:
+	CosmosGame.extra = {}
+	CosmosGame.start_on_foot()
+	var t := CosmosTutor.new()
+	tree.root.add_child(t)
+	return t
+
+
+func _total() -> int:
+	var n := 0
+	for st in CosmosTutor.STEPS:
+		n += int(st[3])
+	return n
+
+
+func test_a_new_game_starts_on_foot_with_the_tutorial() -> void:
+	CosmosGame.extra = {}
+	CosmosGame.start_on_foot()
+	check(not CosmosGame.has_ship(), "no ship at the start")
+	check(str(CosmosGame.extra.get("start", "")) == "Amnissos", "on foot on Amnissos")
+	check(CosmosTutor.active(), "the tutorial on")
+	check(int(CosmosGame.data.ship_value) == 0 and str(CosmosGame.data.ship_class) == "", "nothing to trade in at a shipyard")
+	CosmosGame.extra = {}
+	check(not CosmosTutor.active(), "an old save (no tutorial in it): none")
+
+
+func test_steps_paid_shown_one_at_a_time() -> void:
+	var t := _fresh()
+	var cr0: int = CosmosGame.data.credits
+	check_eq(str(t.current()[1][0]), "walk", "the first step first")
+	t.complete("scan")   # (done out of order)
+	check(t.is_done("scan") and CosmosGame.data.credits == cr0 + 50, "a step done whenever: paid (%d)" % (CosmosGame.data.credits - cr0))
+	check_eq(str(t.current()[1][0]), "walk", "the panel still shows the first not done")
+	t.complete("scan")
+	check(CosmosGame.data.credits == cr0 + 50, "paid once")
+	t.on_event("docked")
+	check(not t.is_done("dock"), "docking counts only after undocking (your bought ship's lift doesn't)")
+	t.on_event("undocked")
+	t.on_event("docked")
+	check(t.is_done("undock") and t.is_done("dock"), "undocked, then docked")
+	t.on_event("pirate_killed")
+	check(not t.is_done("fight"), "one raider: not yet")
+	t.on_event("pirate_killed")
+	check(t.is_done("fight"), "two raiders: done")
+	t.on_event("box_up")
+	check(not t.is_done("drop"), "picking up needs setting down first")
+	t.on_event("box_down")
+	t.on_event("box_up")
+	check(t.is_done("drop"), "set down, picked up")
+	t.free()
+
+
+func test_followed_to_the_end() -> void:
+	var t := _fresh()
+	var cr0: int = CosmosGame.data.credits
+	for st in CosmosTutor.STEPS:
+		if st[0] == "ship":
+			CosmosGame.extra.erase("no_ship")
+			t.on_event("ship_bought")
+		else:
+			check(CosmosTutor.active(), "still on before %s" % st[0])
+			t.complete(str(st[0]))
+	check(not CosmosTutor.active() and bool(CosmosTutor.state().get("finished", false)), "finished at its last step")
+	check(not bool(CosmosTutor.state().get("other_way", false)), "followed: not 'another way'")
+	check(CosmosGame.data.credits == cr0 + _total(), "every step paid once (%d of %d)" % [CosmosGame.data.credits - cr0, _total()])
+	t.free()
+
+
+func test_ship_another_way_ends_it_with_every_reward() -> void:
+	var t := _fresh()
+	var cr0: int = CosmosGame.data.credits
+	t.complete("walk")
+	CosmosGame.extra.erase("no_ship")   # (a ship come by another way, the first part not done)
+	t._process(1.0)
+	check(t.is_done("ship") and bool(CosmosTutor.state().get("other_way", false)), "a ship got another way: noted")
+	check(CosmosTutor.active(), "still on: flying, docking and fighting to learn")
+	t.on_event("undocked")
+	t.on_event("docked")
+	check(CosmosTutor.active(), "not yet: raiders to fight")
+	t.on_event("pirate_killed")
+	t.on_event("pirate_killed")
+	check(not CosmosTutor.active(), "flown, docked, fought: it ends")
+	check(CosmosGame.data.credits == cr0 + _total(), "with every reward it would have paid (%d of %d)" % [CosmosGame.data.credits - cr0, _total()])
+	t.free()
+
+
+func test_the_sandbox_pay() -> void:
+	check(CosmosSandbox.ore_price("iron_ore") > int(Items.info("iron_ore").get("value", 0)), "the ore buyer pays more than its market value")
+	var first_ship := int(Shipyard.stats("player")["price"])
+	var tutor := _total()
+	check(tutor < first_ship, "the tutorial alone doesn't buy a ship (%d of %d)" % [tutor, first_ship])
+	var per := 280 + 60 + 30   # (a delivery's pay, middling)
+	var n := ceili(float(first_ship - tutor) / per)
+	check(n >= 20 and n <= 40, "a few dozen deliveries and the tutorial: a first ship (%d deliveries)" % n)

+extends SceneTree
+## Bakes the grown galaxy (Galaxy.grow_fresh: ~0.5 s of searching) into
+## data/galaxy.json, which the game reads at its start (Galaxy._grow). Run it
+## after changing anything the galaxy grows from (Galaxy.layout_key):
+##   godot --headless --path . -s tools/bake_galaxy.gd
+
+
+func _initialize() -> void:
+	var g: GDScript = load("res://scripts/sim/galaxy.gd")
+	var t := Time.get_ticks_msec()
+	var grown: Array = g.grow_fresh()
+	var f := FileAccess.open(g.LAYOUT_FILE, FileAccess.WRITE)
+	f.store_string(g.layout_json(grown))
+	f.close()
+	print("Galaxy baked: %d systems, %d lanes (%d ms) -> %s" % [grown[0].size(), grown[1].size(), Time.get_ticks_msec() - t, g.LAYOUT_FILE])
+	quit()
